// Game logic
function showMsg(msgs,cb){G.msg=msgs;G.mi2=0;G.tp=0;G.tt=0;G.mc=cb;G.ph='message'}
function advMsg(){
  const t=G.msg[G.mi2]||'';
  if(G.tp<t.length){G.tp=t.length;S.ok()}
  else if(G.mi2<G.msg.length-1){G.mi2++;G.tp=0;S.ok()}
  else{S.ok();if(G.mc)G.mc()}
}

function startBattle(){
  G.pl=P1();G.en=P2();G.pdh=1;G.edh=1;G.pfy=0;G.efy=0;G.ps=0;G.es=0;G.pf=false;G.ef=false;G.plu=0;G.elu=0;
  // Transition
  G.tr=1;G.ph='transition';
  const startTime=G.t;
  function animTr(){
    const elapsed=G.t-startTime;
    G.tr=Math.max(0,1-elapsed/800);
    if(G.tr>0)requestAnimationFrame(animTr);
    else{G.tr=0;
      showMsg([`Wild ${G.en.name} appeared!`,`Go! ${G.pl.name}!`],()=>{G.ph='action';G.mi=0})
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(animTr);
}

function confirmAct(){
  S.ok();
  if(G.mi===0){G.ph='fight';G.moi=0}
  else if(G.mi===1)showMsg(['No items in the Bag!'],()=>G.ph='action');
  else if(G.mi===2)showMsg(['No other Pokémon!'],()=>G.ph='action');
  else{
    if(Math.random()<.7)showMsg(['Got away safely!'],()=>{G.ph='title'});
    else showMsg(["Can't escape!"],()=>execEnemyOnly());
  }
}

function confirmMove(){
  const m=G.pl.moves[G.moi];
  if(m.pp<=0){showMsg(['No PP left for this move!'],()=>G.ph='fight');return}
  S.ok();execBattle(m);
}

function execBattle(pMove){
  const p=G.pl,e=G.en;
  const eMove=e.moves[Math.floor(Math.random()*e.moves.length)];
  const first=p.spe>=e.spe;
  G.bq=[];
  if(first){G.bq.push({a:p,d:e,m:pMove,ip:true});G.bq.push({a:e,d:p,m:eMove,ip:false})}
  else{G.bq.push({a:e,d:p,m:eMove,ip:false});G.bq.push({a:p,d:e,m:pMove,ip:true})}
  G.proc=true;procNext();
}

function procNext(){
  if(!G.bq.length){G.proc=false;G.ph='action';G.mi=0;return}
  const act=G.bq.shift();
  if(act.a.hp<=0){procNext();return}
  act.m.pp--;
  const msgs=[`${act.a.name} used ${act.m.name}!`];
  if(Math.random()*100>act.m.acc){
    msgs.push('But it missed!');
    showMsg(msgs,()=>{if(act.ip)animEShake(()=>procNext());else animPShake(()=>procNext())});
    return;
  }
  const res=calcD(act.a,act.d,act.m);
  if(res.e>1)msgs.push("It's super effective!");
  else if(res.e>0&&res.e<1)msgs.push("It's not very effective...");
  else if(res.e===0)msgs.push(`It doesn't affect ${act.d.name}...`);
  if(res.cr)msgs.push('A critical hit!');
  showMsg(msgs,()=>{
    applyDmg(act.d,res.d,res.e,res.cr,act.ip,()=>{
      if(act.d.hp<=0){
        act.d.hp=0;updHP();
        const fm=[`${act.d.name} fainted!`];
        if(act.d===G.en){fm.push(`You defeated the wild ${act.d.name}!`);showMsg(fm,()=>animFaint(false,()=>{showMsg(['You won! Press ENTER to battle again.'],()=>{G.ph='win'})}))}
        else{fm.push('You blacked out!');showMsg(fm,()=>animFaint(true,()=>{showMsg(['Press ENTER to try again.'],()=>{G.ph='lose'})}))}
      }else procNext();
    });
  });
}

function applyDmg(def,dmg,eff,crit,isPA,cb){
  def.hp=Math.max(0,def.hp-dmg);
  if(isPA){
    animPAtk(()=>{if(eff>1)S.sup();else if(eff<1&&eff>0)S.not();else S.hit();if(crit)setTimeout(S.crt,200);animEShake(()=>animHP(!isPA,cb))});
  }else{
    animEAtk(()=>{if(eff>1)S.sup();else if(eff<1&&eff>0)S.not();else S.hit();if(crit)setTimeout(S.crt,200);animPShake(()=>animHP(!isPA,cb))});
  }
}

function execEnemyOnly(){
  const e=G.en,p=G.pl;if(e.hp<=0)return;
  const em=e.moves[Math.floor(Math.random()*e.moves.length)];em.pp--;
  const msgs=[`${e.name} used ${em.name}!`];
  if(Math.random()*100>em.acc){msgs.push('But it missed!');showMsg(msgs,()=>{animPShake(()=>{G.ph='action';G.mi=0})});return}
  const res=calcD(e,p,em);
  if(res.e>1)msgs.push("It's super effective!");
  else if(res.e>0&&res.e<1)msgs.push("It's not very effective...");
  if(res.cr)msgs.push('A critical hit!');
  showMsg(msgs,()=>{
    p.hp=Math.max(0,p.hp-res.d);
    S.hit();if(res.e>1)setTimeout(S.sup,200);
    animPShake(()=>animHP(true,()=>{
      if(p.hp<=0)showMsg([`${p.name} fainted!`,'You blacked out!'],()=>animFaint(true,()=>{showMsg(['Press ENTER to try again.'],()=>{G.ph='lose'})}));
      else{G.ph='action';G.mi=0}
    }));
  });
}

function updHP(){G.pdh=G.pl.hp/G.pl.mHp;G.edh=G.en.hp/G.en.mHp}

// Animations
function animPAtk(cb){const s=performance.now();(function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/280);G.plu=t<.5?t*2*45:(1-t)*2*45;if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{G.plu=0;cb()}})(performance.now())}
function animEAtk(cb){const s=performance.now();(function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/280);G.elu=t<.5?-(t*2*45):-((1-t)*2*45);if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{G.elu=0;cb()}})(performance.now())}
function animPShake(cb){const s=performance.now();G.pf=true;(function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/400);G.ps=Math.sin(t*Math.PI*8)*(1-t)*10;G.ft=n-s;if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{G.ps=0;G.pf=false;cb()}})(performance.now())}
function animEShake(cb){const s=performance.now();G.ef=true;(function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/400);G.es=Math.sin(t*Math.PI*8)*(1-t)*10;G.ft=n-s;if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{G.es=0;G.ef=false;cb()}})(performance.now())}
function animHP(isP,cb){const s=performance.now();const tgt=isP?G.pl.hp/G.pl.mHp:G.en.hp/G.en.mHp;const start=isP?G.pdh:G.edh;
  (function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/500);const v=start+(tgt-start)*t;if(isP)G.pdh=v;else G.edh=v;
    if(t<.95&&Math.random()<.15)S.hp();
    if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else{if(isP)G.pdh=tgt;else G.edh=tgt;cb()}})(performance.now())}
function animFaint(isP,cb){const s=performance.now();S.fnt();(function step(n){const t=Math.min(1,(n-s)/700);if(isP)G.pfy=t*70;else G.efy=t*70;if(t<1)requestAnimationFrame(step);else cb()})(performance.now())}

// Input
function handleKey(k){
  initA();
  if(G.ph==='title'){if(k==='Enter'||k==='z'||k==='Z'){S.ok();startBattle()}return}
  if(G.ph==='message'){if(k==='Enter'||k==='z'||k==='Z'||k===' ')advMsg();return}
  if(G.ph==='action'){
    if(k==='ArrowUp'&&G.mi>=2){G.mi-=2;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='ArrowDown'&&G.mi<2){G.mi+=2;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='ArrowLeft'&&G.mi%2===1){G.mi--;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='ArrowRight'&&G.mi%2===0){G.mi++;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='Enter'||k==='z'||k==='Z')confirmAct();
    return;
  }
  if(G.ph==='fight'){
    if(k==='ArrowUp'&&G.moi>0){G.moi--;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='ArrowDown'&&G.moi<G.pl.moves.length-1){G.moi++;S.sel()}
    else if(k==='Enter'||k==='z'||k==='Z')confirmMove();
    else if(k==='Escape'||k==='x'||k==='X'||k==='Backspace'){S.no();G.ph='action'}
    return;
  }
  if(G.ph==='win'||G.ph==='lose'){if(k==='Enter'||k==='z'||k==='Z'){S.ok();G.ph='title';G.pfy=0;G.efy=0}return}
}
document.addEventListener('keydown',e=>{e.preventDefault();handleKey(e.key)});

// Click/touch support
function handleClick(cx,cy){
  initA();
  if(G.ph==='title'){S.ok();startBattle();return}
  if(G.ph==='message'){advMsg();return}
  if(G.ph==='action'){
    const ps=[[356,310],[488,310],[356,370],[488,370]];
    for(let i=0;i<4;i++){const[ox,oy]=ps[i];if(cx>=ox-10&&cx<=ox+130&&cy>=oy-10&&cy<=oy+30){G.mi=i;S.sel();confirmAct();return}}
    // Also check if clicking in the text box area to advance message
    return;
  }
  if(G.ph==='fight'){
    const sx=38,sy=298;
    for(let i=0;i<G.pl.moves.length;i++){
      const my=sy+i*38;
      if(cx>=sx-10&&cx<=sx+300&&cy>=my-10&&cy<=my+30){G.moi=i;S.sel();confirmMove();return}
    }
    // Back button area
    if(cx>=370&&cx<=530&&cy>=380&&cy<=410){S.no();G.ph='action';return}
    return;
  }
  if(G.ph==='win'||G.ph==='lose'){S.ok();G.ph='title';G.pfy=0;G.efy=0;return}
}
C.addEventListener('click',e=>{
  const r=C.getBoundingClientRect();
  const sx=640/r.width,sy=480/r.height;
  handleClick((e.clientX-r.left)*sx,(e.clientY-r.top)*sy);
});
C.addEventListener('touchstart',e=>{
  e.preventDefault();
  const r=C.getBoundingClientRect();
  const t=e.touches[0];
  const sx=640/r.width,sy=480/r.height;
  handleClick((t.clientX-r.left)*sx,(t.clientY-r.top)*sy);
},{passive:false});

// Game loop
function loop(ts){
  G.t=ts;
  if(G.ph==='message'&&G.msg.length){
    const t=G.msg[G.mi2]||'';
    if(G.tp<t.length){G.tt+=16;if(G.tt>=28){G.tp++;G.tt=0;S.txt()}}
  }
  render();
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
requestAnimationFrame(loop);
})();
</script>

prompt: Recreate a Pokémon battle UI — make it interactive, nostalgic, and fun. Stick to the spirit of a classic battle, but feel free to get creative if you want. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
    <title>Pokémon Battle · Classic</title>
    <style>
        /* ─── RESET & BASE ─── */
        * {
            margin: 0;
            padding: 0;
            box-sizing: border-box;
            user-select: none;
        }

        body {
            background: #1a1a2e;
            min-height: 100vh;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            padding: 16px;
        }

        /* ─── GAME BOY FRAME ─── */
        .gameboy {
            background: #3a2a1a;
            padding: 20px 20px 30px;
            border-radius: 40px 40px 30px 30px;
            box-shadow:
                0 12px 0 #1f140e,
                0 20px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.7),
                inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            border: 2px solid #5a4a3a;
            position: relative;
            max-width: 720px;
            width: 100%;
        }
        .gameboy::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            bottom: -8px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            width: 60px;
            height: 6px;
            background: #2a1a0a;
            border-radius: 10px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
        }

        /* ─── SCREEN ─── */
        .screen {
            background: #9bbc0f;
            border-radius: 20px;
            padding: 16px 18px 14px;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 0 0 4px #306230,
                inset 0 0 0 8px #0f380f,
                0 4px 0 #1f140e;
            position: relative;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
        }
        .screen-inner {
            background: #9bbc0f;
            border-radius: 12px;
            overflow: hidden;
            position: relative;
        }

        /* ─── BATTLE SCENE ─── */
        .battle-scene {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg,
                    #6bb5de 0%,
                    #7ec8e3 30%,
                    #8fd6f0 50%,
                    #5fadc5 52%,
                    #4a9a3a 55%,
                    #3d8a2d 70%,
                    #2d6b1e 100%);
            min-height: 280px;
            position: relative;
            border-radius: 8px 8px 0 0;
            padding: 12px 16px 8px;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            border-bottom: 4px solid #0f380f;
        }

        /* clouds */
        .cloud {
            position: absolute;
            color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.25);
            font-size: 32px;
            top: 8px;
            animation: floatCloud 18s ease-in-out infinite;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .cloud.c2 {
            top: 28px;
            font-size: 24px;
            animation-duration: 24s;
            animation-delay: -6s;
            left: 40%;
        }
        .cloud.c3 {
            top: 12px;
            font-size: 20px;
            animation-duration: 20s;
            animation-delay: -12s;
            left: 70%;
        }
        @keyframes floatCloud {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            50% {
                transform: translateX(60px);
            }
        }

        /* grass details */
        .grass-blades {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 8px;
            left: 0;
            right: 0;
            height: 20px;
            pointer-events: none;
            background: repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,
                    transparent 0px,
                    transparent 12px,
                    #3d8a2d 12px,
                    #3d8a2d 14px,
                    transparent 14px,
                    transparent 28px);
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* ─── POKEMON SPRITES ─── */
        .sprite-area {
            position: relative;
            height: 180px;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: flex-end;
            padding: 0 8px;
        }

        .sprite-wrapper {
            position: relative;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            transition: transform 0.15s ease;
        }

        .sprite-wrapper.opponent {
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: 12px;
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.player {
            align-items: center;
            margin-bottom: -4px;
        }

        .pkmn-sprite {
            font-size: 72px;
            line-height: 1;
            filter: drop-shadow(0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.3));
            transition: transform 0.2s ease, filter 0.2s ease;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.opponent .pkmn-sprite {
            font-size: 64px;
            transform: scaleX(-1);
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.player .pkmn-sprite {
            font-size: 80px;
        }

        .pkmn-sprite.hit {
            animation: spriteHit 0.3s ease;
        }
        @keyframes spriteHit {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1);
            }
            20% {
                transform: translateX(-8px) scaleX(-1);
            }
            40% {
                transform: translateX(6px) scaleX(-1);
            }
            60% {
                transform: translateX(-4px) scaleX(-1);
            }
            80% {
                transform: translateX(2px) scaleX(-1);
            }
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.player .pkmn-sprite.hit {
            animation: spriteHitPlayer 0.3s ease;
        }
        @keyframes spriteHitPlayer {
            0%,
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            20% {
                transform: translateX(8px);
            }
            40% {
                transform: translateX(-6px);
            }
            60% {
                transform: translateX(4px);
            }
            80% {
                transform: translateX(-2px);
            }
        }

        .pkmn-sprite.attack-anim {
            animation: attackLunge 0.35s ease;
        }
        @keyframes attackLunge {
            0% {
                transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1);
            }
            30% {
                transform: translateX(20px) scaleX(-1) scale(1.06);
            }
            60% {
                transform: translateX(-4px) scaleX(-1) scale(0.96);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1);
            }
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.player .pkmn-sprite.attack-anim {
            animation: attackLungePlayer 0.35s ease;
        }
        @keyframes attackLungePlayer {
            0% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            30% {
                transform: translateX(-20px) scale(1.06);
            }
            60% {
                transform: translateX(4px) scale(0.96);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
        }

        .sprite-name {
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #0f380f;
            background: rgba(155, 188, 15, 0.7);
            padding: 1px 10px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            margin-top: 2px;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            border: 1px solid #306230;
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.opponent .sprite-name {
            background: rgba(235, 80, 80, 0.2);
            border-color: #a04040;
            color: #4a1a1a;
        }
        .sprite-wrapper.player .sprite-name {
            background: rgba(60, 120, 200, 0.2);
            border-color: #3050a0;
            color: #1a2a4a;
        }

        /* ─── HP BARS ─── */
        .hud-top,
        .hud-bottom {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: stretch;
            gap: 10px;
        }

        .hud-top {
            margin-bottom: 2px;
        }
        .hud-bottom {
            margin-top: 2px;
        }

        .hp-panel {
            background: rgba(15, 56, 15, 0.70);
            border: 2px solid #0f380f;
            border-radius: 12px;
            padding: 4px 12px 6px;
            min-width: 130px;
            backdrop-filter: blur(1px);
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
        }
        .hp-panel.opponent {
            align-self: flex-start;
            background: rgba(15, 56, 15, 0.75);
        }
        .hp-panel.player {
            align-self: flex-end;
            background: rgba(15, 56, 15, 0.75);
        }

        .hp-header {
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #d0e8a0;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0f380f;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
            margin-bottom: 1px;
        }
        .hp-header .lvl {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #b0c890;
        }
        .hp-header .lvl span {
            color: #d0e8a0;
            font-size: 11px;
        }

        .hp-bar-bg {
            background: #1a3a1a;
            height: 8px;
            border-radius: 20px;
            border: 1px solid #0f280f;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin: 2px 0 1px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.5);
        }
        .hp-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 100%;
            border-radius: 20px;
            transition: width 0.45s ease, background 0.3s ease;
            background: #48d050;
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(72, 208, 80, 0.3);
        }
        .hp-bar-fill.low {
            background: #e84040;
            box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(232, 64, 64, 0.4);
        }
        .hp-bar-fill.mid {
            background: #f0c840;
            box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(240, 200, 64, 0.3);
        }

        .hp-numbers {
            font-size: 10px;
            color: #b0c890;
            text-align: right;
            font-weight: bold;
            letter-spacing: 0.2px;
            margin-top: -1px;
        }
        .hp-numbers span {
            color: #d0e8a0;
        }

        /* EXP bar */
        .exp-bar-bg {
            background: #1a2a1a;
            height: 4px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            border: 1px solid #0f1f0f;
            overflow: hidden;
            margin-top: 3px;
        }
        .exp-bar-fill {
            height: 100%;
            width: 60%;
            background: #80d0f0;
            border-radius: 10px;
            transition: width 0.6s ease;
        }

        /* ─── BATTLE TEXT / MENU ─── */
        .battle-footer {
            background: #0f380f;
            border-radius: 0 0 12px 12px;
            padding: 8px 12px 8px;
            border-top: 4px solid #306230;
            min-height: 110px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
        }

        .text-box {
            background: #1a3a1a;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 8px 12px;
            min-height: 48px;
            flex: 1;
            border: 2px solid #306230;
            box-shadow: inset 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
            margin-bottom: 6px;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
        }
        .text-box p {
            color: #c0d8a0;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            letter-spacing: 0.2px;
            text-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0f280f;
            line-height: 1.4;
            min-height: 2.2em;
        }
        .text-box p .cursor-blink {
            animation: blink 0.7s step-end infinite;
            color: #d0e8a0;
            font-weight: normal;
        }
        @keyframes blink {
            0%,
            100% {
                opacity: 1;
            }
            50% {
                opacity: 0;
            }
        }

        .text-box p .effect-label {
            display: inline-block;
            font-size: 12px;
            padding: 0 6px;
            border-radius: 4px;
            margin-left: 4px;
            font-weight: bold;
        }
        .effect-label.super {
            color: #f0f080;
            background: rgba(200, 80, 40, 0.4);
            text-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(240, 240, 128, 0.3);
        }
        .effect-label.not-very {
            color: #80b0d0;
            background: rgba(40, 80, 120, 0.3);
        }
        .effect-label.crit {
            color: #f0a0a0;
            background: rgba(200, 40, 40, 0.25);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(240, 160, 160, 0.2);
        }
        .effect-label.miss {
            color: #b08080;
            background: rgba(80, 40, 40, 0.2);
        }
        .effect-label.faint {
            color: #f0d0a0;
            background: rgba(160, 100, 40, 0.3);
            text-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(240, 208, 160, 0.2);
        }

        /* ─── COMMAND MENU ─── */
        .menu-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .menu-btn {
            background: #1a3a1a;
            border: 2px solid #306230;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 6px 2px;
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            font-size: 12px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #c0d8a0;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.8px;
            transition: all 0.12s ease;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0f280f;
        }
        .menu-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: #2a5a2a;
            border-color: #60b060;
            color: #f0f8e0;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #0f280f;
        }
        .menu-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(1px);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0f280f;
        }
        .menu-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.35;
            cursor: not-allowed;
            transform: none;
        }
        .menu-btn.selected {
            background: #2a5a2a;
            border-color: #80d080;
            color: #e0f8d0;
            box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(128, 208, 128, 0.15);
        }

        /* Move buttons (shown when FIGHT is selected) */
        .move-grid {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
            gap: 4px;
        }
        .move-btn {
            background: #1a2a3a;
            border: 2px solid #305070;
            border-radius: 6px;
            padding: 5px 4px;
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            font-size: 11px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #a0c8e0;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 0.3px;
            transition: all 0.12s ease;
            text-align: left;
            display: flex;
            justify-content: space-between;
            align-items: center;
            box-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0f1f2f;
            line-height: 1.2;
        }
        .move-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
            background: #2a4a6a;
            border-color: #6090c0;
            color: #d0ecff;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #0f1f2f;
        }
        .move-btn:active:not(:disabled) {
            transform: translateY(1px);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #0f1f2f;
        }
        .move-btn:disabled {
            opacity: 0.35;
            cursor: not-allowed;
        }
        .move-btn .move-type {
            font-size: 8px;
            padding: 1px 6px;
            border-radius: 10px;
            background: #1a2a3a;
            border: 1px solid #305070;
            color: #80a0c0;
            letter-spacing: 0.5px;
        }
        .move-btn .move-power {
            font-size: 9px;
            color: #7088a0;
        }

        /* type badge colors */
        .type-Fire {
            background: #f08030 !important;
            border-color: #c06020 !important;
            color: #fff0e0 !important;
        }
        .type-Water {
            background: #6890f0 !important;
            border-color: #4870c0 !important;
            color: #e8f0ff !important;
        }
        .type-Grass {
            background: #78c850 !important;
            border-color: #58a030 !important;
            color: #f0ffe8 !important;
        }
        .type-Poison {
            background: #a040a0 !important;
            border-color: #782878 !important;
            color: #f0e0f0 !important;
        }
        .type-Flying {
            background: #a890f0 !important;
            border-color: #7868c0 !important;
            color: #f0e8ff !important;
        }
        .type-Normal {
            background: #a8a878 !important;
            border-color: #807860 !important;
            color: #f8f8e8 !important;
        }
        .type-Dragon {
            background: #7038f8 !important;
            border-color: #5020c8 !important;
            color: #f0e8ff !important;
        }
        .type-Ghost {
            background: #705898 !important;
            border-color: #483868 !important;
            color: #e8e0f0 !important;
        }
        .type-Psychic {
            background: #f85888 !important;
            border-color: #c03060 !important;
            color: #fff0f4 !important;
        }
        .type-Ice {
            background: #98d8d8 !important;
            border-color: #68a8a8 !important;
            color: #e8f8f8 !important;
        }
        .type-Rock {
            background: #b8a038 !important;
            border-color: #887820 !important;
            color: #f8f0d0 !important;
        }
        .type-Ground {
            background: #e0c068 !important;
            border-color: #b89838 !important;
            color: #f8f0d0 !important;
        }
        .type-Electric {
            background: #f8d030 !important;
            border-color: #c0a010 !important;
            color: #3a2a00 !important;
        }
        .type-Fighting {
            background: #c03028 !important;
            border-color: #901810 !important;
            color: #ffe8e0 !important;
        }
        .type-Bug {
            background: #a8b820 !important;
            border-color: #788810 !important;
            color: #f8fce0 !important;
        }

        /* ─── STATUS OVERLAY ─── */
        .status-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.45);
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 8px;
            z-index: 10;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
        }
        .status-overlay.active {
            opacity: 1;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box {
            background: #0f380f;
            border: 4px solid #306230;
            border-radius: 16px;
            padding: 20px 32px;
            text-align: center;
            box-shadow: 0 8px 0 #0a2a0a, 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            max-width: 85%;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box h2 {
            color: #d0e8a0;
            font-size: 22px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            text-shadow: 0 2px 0 #0f280f;
            margin-bottom: 4px;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box p {
            color: #b0c890;
            font-size: 13px;
            margin-bottom: 10px;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box .btn-restart {
            background: #306230;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 8px 28px;
            font-family: 'Courier New', Courier, monospace;
            font-size: 14px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #d0e8a0;
            cursor: pointer;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            box-shadow: 0 3px 0 #1a3a1a;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box .btn-restart:hover {
            background: #408040;
            transform: translateY(-1px);
            box-shadow: 0 4px 0 #1a3a1a;
        }
        .status-overlay .status-box .btn-restart:active {
            transform: translateY(2px);
            box-shadow: 0 1px 0 #1a3a1a;
        }

        /* ─── ATTACK PARTICLES ─── */
        .particle-container {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            overflow: hidden;
            border-radius: 8px;
            z-index: 5;
        }
        .particle {
            position: absolute;
            font-size: 20px;
            opacity: 0;
            animation: particleFly 0.7s ease forwards;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        @keyframes particleFly {
            0% {
                opacity: 1;
                transform: translate(0, 0) scale(1) rotate(0deg);
            }
            100% {
                opacity: 0;
                transform: translate(var(--tx), var(--ty)) scale(0.2) rotate(360deg);
            }
        }

        .flash-overlay {
            position: absolute;
            inset: 0;
            background: white;
            opacity: 0;
            pointer-events: none;
            border-radius: 8px;
            z-index: 4;
            transition: opacity 0.05s ease;
        }
        .flash-overlay.active {
            opacity: 0.5;
        }

        /* ─── RESPONSIVE ─── */
        @media (max-width: 500px) {
            .gameboy {
                padding: 12px 10px 20px;
                border-radius: 24px;
            }
            .screen {
                padding: 10px 10px 8px;
                border-radius: 14px;
            }
            .battle-scene {
                min-height: 200px;
                padding: 8px 8px 4px;
            }
            .sprite-area {
                height: 120px;
            }
            .pkmn-sprite {
                font-size: 48px !important;

    <script>
        // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
        //  POKÉMON BATTLE ENGINE
        // ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

        // ─── TYPE EFFECTIVENESS ───
        const TYPE_CHART = {
            Fire: { Fire: 0.5, Water: 0.5, Grass: 2.0, Ice: 2.0, Bug: 2.0, Rock: 0.5, Dragon: 0.5, Steel: 2.0 },
            Water: { Fire: 2.0, Water: 0.5, Grass: 0.5, Ground: 2.0, Rock: 2.0, Dragon: 0.5 },

            Ice: { Fire: 0.5, Water: 0.5, Grass: 2.0, Ice: 0.5, Ground: 2.0, Flying: 2.0, Dragon: 2.0, Steel: 0.5 },
            Rock: { Fire: 2.0, Ice: 2.0, Fighting: 0.5, Ground: 0.5, Flying: 2.0, Bug: 2.0, Steel: 0.5 },
            Ground: { Fire: 2.0, Grass: 0.5, Electric: 2.0, Poison: 2.0, Flying: 0.0, Bug: 0.5, Rock: 2.0, Steel: 2.0 },
            Electric: { Water: 2.0, Grass: 0.5, Electric: 0.5, Ground: 0.0, Flying: 2.0, Dragon: 0.5 },
            Fighting: { Normal: 2.0, Ice: 2.0, Poison: 0.5, Flying: 0.5, Psychic: 0.5, Bug: 0.5, Rock: 2.0, Ghost: 0.0,
                Dark: 2.0, Steel: 2.0, Fairy: 0.5 },
            Bug: { Fire: 0.5, Grass: 2.0, Fighting: 0.5, Poison: 0.5, Flying: 0.5, Psychic: 2.0, Ghost: 0.5, Dark: 2.0,
                Steel: 0.5, Fairy: 0.5 },
            Dark: { Fighting: 0.5, Psychic: 2.0, Bug: 0.5, Ghost: 2.0, Dark: 0.5, Fairy: 0.5, Steel: 0.5 },
            Steel: { Fire: 0.5, Water: 0.5, Grass: 0.5, Ice: 2.0, Fighting: 0.5, Poison: 0.0, Ground: 0.5, Flying: 0.5,
                Psychic: 0.5, Bug: 0.5, Rock: 2.0, Dragon: 0.5, Steel: 0.5, Fairy: 2.0 },
            Fairy: { Fire: 0.5, Poison: 0.5, Fighting: 2.0, Dragon: 2.0, Dark: 2.0, Steel: 0.5 },
        };

        function getEffectiveness(moveType, defenderType) {
            const chart = TYPE_CHART[moveType];
            if (!chart) return 1.0;
            return chart[defenderType] ?? 1.0;
        }

        // ─── POKEMON DATA ───
        const MOVES = {
            flamethrower: { name: 'Flamethrower', type: 'Fire', power: 90, accuracy: 100 },
            dragonClaw: { name: 'Dragon Claw', type: 'Dragon', power: 80, accuracy: 100 },
            airSlash: { name: 'Air Slash', type: 'Flying', power: 75, accuracy: 95 },
            shadowClaw: { name: 'Shadow Claw', type: 'Ghost', power: 70, accuracy: 100 },
            solarBeam: { name: 'Solar Beam', type: 'Grass', power: 120, accuracy: 100 },
            sludgeBomb: { name: 'Sludge Bomb', type: 'Poison', power: 90, accuracy: 100 },
            vineWhip: { name: 'Vine Whip', type: 'Grass', power: 45, accuracy: 100 },
            bodySlam: { name: 'Body Slam', type: 'Normal', power: 85, accuracy: 100 },
            thunderPunch: { name: 'Thunder Punch', type: 'Electric', power: 75, accuracy: 100 },
            iceBeam: { name: 'Ice Beam', type: 'Ice', power: 90, accuracy: 100 },
        };

        const PLAYER_POKEMON = {
            name: 'Charizard',
            type: 'Fire',
            level: 50,
            maxHP: 160,
            currentHP: 160,
            sprite: '🔥',
            spriteEmoji: '🔥',
            moves: [
                MOVES.flamethrower,
                MOVES.dragonClaw,
                MOVES.airSlash,
                MOVES.shadowClaw,
            ],
        };

        const OPPONENT_POKEMON = {
            name: 'Venusaur',
            type: 'Grass',
            level: 50,
            maxHP: 150,
            currentHP: 150,
            sprite: '🌿',
            spriteEmoji: '🌿',
            moves: [
                MOVES.solarBeam,
                MOVES.sludgeBomb,
                MOVES.vineWhip,
                MOVES.bodySlam,
            ],
        };

        // ─── STATE ───
        let player = null;
        let opponent = null;
        let isPlayerTurn = true;
        let battleActive = false;
        let animating = false;
        let textQueue = [];
        let isTextRunning = false;

        // DOM refs
        const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
        const battleText = $('battleText');
        const textBox = $('textBox');
        const mainMenu = $('mainMenu');
        const moveMenu = $('moveMenu');
        const menuContainer = $('menuContainer');
        const statusOverlay = $('statusOverlay');
        const statusTitle = $('statusTitle');
        const statusSub = $('statusSub');
        const btnRestart = $('btnRestart');
        const flashOverlay = $('flashOverlay');
        const particleContainer = $('particleContainer');

        const opponentSprite = $('opponentSprite');
        const playerSprite = $('playerSprite');
        const opponentName = $('opponentName');
        const playerName = $('playerName');
        const opponentHpName = $('opponentHpName');
        const playerHpName = $('playerHpName');
        const opponentHpBar = $('opponentHpBar');
        const playerHpBar = $('playerHpBar');
        const opponentHpCurrent = $('opponentHpCurrent');
        const opponentHpMax = $('opponentHpMax');
        const playerHpCurrent = $('playerHpCurrent');
        const playerHpMax = $('playerHpMax');
        const opponentLevel = $('opponentLevel');
        const playerLevel = $('playerLevel');
        const expBar = $('expBar');

        const opponentWrapper = $('opponentWrapper');
        const playerWrapper = $('playerWrapper');

        // ─── SOUND (simple beeps via Web Audio) ───
        let audioCtx = null;

        function initAudio() {
            if (!audioCtx) {
                try { audioCtx = new(window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)(); } catch (_) {}
            }
        }

        function playBeep(freq, duration, type = 'square', vol = 0.12) {
            try {
                initAudio();
                if (!audioCtx) return;
                const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
                const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
                osc.type = type;
                osc.frequency.value = freq;
                gain.gain.value = vol;
                gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
                osc.connect(gain);
                gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
                osc.start(audioCtx.currentTime);
                osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + duration);
            } catch (_) {}
        }

        function soundSelect() { playBeep(600, 0.08, 'square', 0.08); }

        function soundConfirm() { playBeep(800, 0.12, 'square', 0.10);
            setTimeout(() => playBeep(1000, 0.10, 'square', 0.08), 80); }

        function soundHit() { playBeep(200, 0.18, 'sawtooth', 0.12);
            playBeep(120, 0.22, 'sawtooth', 0.08); }

        function soundSuper() { playBeep(400, 0.10, 'square', 0.10);
            setTimeout(() => playBeep(600, 0.10, 'square', 0.10), 60);
            setTimeout(() => playBeep(800, 0.14, 'square', 0.10), 120); }

        function soundFaint() { playBeep(300, 0.20, 'sawtooth', 0.10);
            setTimeout(() => playBeep(200, 0.25, 'sawtooth', 0.08), 150);
            setTimeout(() => playBeep(100, 0.40, 'sawtooth', 0.06), 320); }

        function soundWin() {
            [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => {
                setTimeout(() => playBeep(f, 0.15, 'square', 0.08), i * 100);
            });
        }

        function soundLose() {
            [400, 350, 300, 200].forEach((f, i) => {
                setTimeout(() => playBeep(f, 0.20, 'sawtooth', 0.08), i * 120);
            });
        }

        // ─── HELPERS ───
        function clamp(v, min, max) { return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, v)); }

        function randomRange(min, max) { return Math.random() * (max - min) + min; }

        function randomInt(min, max) { return Math.floor(randomRange(min, max + 1)); }

        function delay(ms) { return new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); }

        // ─── TEXT SYSTEM ───
        function setText(text, instant = false) {
            return new Promise(async (resolve) => {
                if (isTextRunning && !instant) {
                    textQueue.push(text);
                    return resolve();
                }
                isTextRunning = true;
                const el = battleText;
                el.innerHTML = '';
                if (instant) {
                    el.innerHTML = text + '<span class="cursor-blink">▌</span>';
                    isTextRunning = false;
                    return resolve();
                }
                // typewriter
                const chars = text.split('');
                for (let i = 0; i < chars.length; i++) {
                    el.innerHTML = chars.slice(0, i + 1).join('') + '<span class="cursor-blink">▌</span>';
                    if (chars[i] !== ' ') playBeep(900 + Math.random() * 200, 0.025, 'square', 0.02);
                    await delay(12 + (chars[i] === '.' || chars[i] === '!' || chars[i] === '?' ? 120 : 0));
                }
                await delay(60);
                isTextRunning = false;
                resolve();
                // check queue
                if (textQueue.length > 0) {
                    const next = textQueue.shift();
                    setText(next);
                }
            });
        }

        async function showText(text) {
            await setText(text);
            // wait for click / tap
            return new Promise(resolve => {
                const handler = (e) => {
                    if (animating) return;
                    document.removeEventListener('click', handler);
                    document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handler);
                    resolve();
                };
                document.addEventListener('click', handler);
                document.addEventListener('touchstart', handler);
                // also resolve on any keypress
                const keyHandler = (e) => {
                    if (animating) return;
                    document.removeEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);
                    resolve();
                };
                document.addEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    document.removeEventListener('click', handler);
                    document.removeEventListener('touchstart', handler);
                    document.removeEventListener('keydown', keyHandler);
                    resolve();
                }, 4000);
            });
        }

        async function showTextAuto(text, delayMs = 600) {
            await setText(text);
            await delay(delayMs);
        }

        // ─── HP BAR UPDATE ───
        function updateHp(target, hpCurrent, hpMax, animate = true) {
            const isPlayer = target === 'player';
            const bar = isPlayer ? playerHpBar : opponentHpBar;
            const currentEl = isPlayer ? playerHpCurrent : opponentHpCurrent;
            const maxEl = isPlayer ? playerHpMax : opponentHpMax;
            const percent = clamp((hpCurrent / hpMax) * 100, 0, 100);

            currentEl.textContent = hpCurrent;
            maxEl.textContent = hpMax;

            if (animate) {
                bar.style.transition = 'width 0.45s ease';
            } else {
                bar.style.transition = 'none';
            }
            bar.style.width = percent + '%';

            // color
            bar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
            if (percent <= 20) bar.classList.add('low');
            else if (percent <= 48) bar.classList.add('mid');
        }

        function updateAllHp(animate = true) {
            updateHp('player', player.currentHP, player.maxHP, animate);
            updateHp('opponent', opponent.currentHP, opponent.maxHP, animate);
        }

        function updateExp() {
            const pct = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
            expBar.style.width = pct + '%';
        }

        // ─── PARTICLES ───
        function spawnParticles(emoji, count = 8, target = 'opponent') {
            const container = particleContainer;
            const rect = container.getBoundingClientRect();
            const isOpp = target === 'opponent';
            const cx = isOpp ? rect.width * 0.65 : rect.width * 0.35;
            const cy = rect.height * 0.45;

            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                const el = document.createElement('div');
                el.className = 'particle';
                el.textContent = emoji;
                const angle = (Math.PI * 2 * i) / count + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.8;
                const dist = 40 + Math.random() * 80;
                const tx = Math.cos(angle) * dist;
                const ty = Math.sin(angle) * dist - 30;
                el.style.left = cx + 'px';
                el.style.top = cy + 'px';
                el.style.setProperty('--tx', tx + 'px');
                el.style.setProperty('--ty', ty + 'px');
                el.style.fontSize = (14 + Math.random() * 18) + 'px';
                el.style.animationDuration = (0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4) + 's';
                el.style.animationDelay = (Math.random() * 0.15) + 's';
                container.appendChild(el);
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 900);
            }
        }

        function flashScreen() {
            flashOverlay.classList.add('active');
            setTimeout(() => flashOverlay.classList.remove('active'), 120);
        }

        // ─── DAMAGE CALC ───
        function calculateDamage(attacker, defender, move) {
            // base damage formula (simplified but fun)
            const level = attacker.level;
            const power = move.power;
            const attack = 100 + level * 1.5;
            const defense = 100 + defender.level * 1.4;
            const base = ((2 * level / 5 + 2) * power * attack / defense / 50 + 2);

            // random variance 85-100%
            const variance = randomRange(0.85, 1.0);

            // critical hit (10%)
            const isCrit = Math.random() < 0.10;
            const critMul = isCrit ? 1.8 : 1.0;

            // type effectiveness
            const eff = getEffectiveness(move.type, defender.type);

            // STAB (same type attack bonus)
            const stab = attacker.type === move.type ? 1.5 : 1.0;

            let damage = Math.floor(base * variance * critMul * stab * eff);
            damage = Math.max(1, damage);

            return {
                damage,
                isCrit,
                effectiveness: eff,
                stab,
            };
        }

        // ─── EXECUTE MOVE ───
        async function executeMove(attacker, defender, move, attackerIsPlayer) {
            const result = calculateDamage(attacker, defender, move);
            const { damage, isCrit, effectiveness } = result;

            // animate attacker
            const wrapper = attackerIsPlayer ? playerWrapper : opponentWrapper;
            const sprite = attackerIsPlayer ? playerSprite : opponentSprite;
            const defWrapper = attackerIsPlayer ? opponentWrapper : playerWrapper;
            const defSprite = attackerIsPlayer ? opponentSprite : playerSprite;

            // attack lunge
            sprite.classList.add('attack-anim');
            await delay(200);
            sprite.classList.remove('attack-anim');

            // hit effect
            defSprite.classList.add('hit');
            flashScreen();
            soundHit();

            // particles based on move type
            const particleEmojis = {
                Fire: '🔥',
                Water: '💧',
                Grass: '🌿',
                Electric: '⚡',
                Ice: '❄️',
                Flying: '💨',
                Poison: '☠️',
                Dragon: '🐉',
                Ghost: '👻',
                Psychic: '🔮',
                Rock: '🪨',
                Ground: '🏜️',
                Bug: '🐛',
                Fighting: '👊',
                Normal: '💥',
                Dark: '🌑',
                Steel: '⚙️',
                Fairy: '✨',
            };
            const pEmoji = particleEmojis[move.type] || '💥';
            spawnParticles(pEmoji, 10, attackerIsPlayer ? 'opponent' : 'player');
            await delay(150);

            // apply damage
            defender.currentHP = Math.max(0, defender.currentHP - damage);
            updateHp(attackerIsPlayer ? 'opponent' : 'player', defender.currentHP, defender.maxHP, true);

            // effectiveness text
            let effText = '';
            if (effectiveness >= 2.0) {
                effText = '<span class="effect-label super">★ Super effective!</span>';
                soundSuper();
            } else if (effectiveness <= 0.5 && effectiveness > 0) {
                effText = '<span class="effect-label not-very">△ Not very effective...</span>';
            } else if (effectiveness === 0) {
                effText = '<span class="effect-label miss">✕ No effect!</span>';
            }
            let critText = '';
            if (isCrit) {
                critText = '<span class="effect-label crit">★ Critical hit!</span>';
                soundSuper();
            }

            const moveName = move.name;
            const attackerName = attacker.name;
            let msg = `${attackerName} used <strong>${moveName}</strong>!`;
            if (effectiveness === 0) {
                msg += ` ${effText}`;
            } else {
                if (critText) msg += ` ${critText}`;
                if (effText) msg += ` ${effText}`;
            }

            await showTextAuto(msg, 500);

            // faint check
            if (defender.currentHP <= 0) {
                defSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                await showTextAuto(`${defender.name} fainted! <span class="effect-label faint">💫</span>`, 500);
                soundFaint();
                return 'faint';
            }

            defSprite.classList.remove('hit');
            return 'ok';
        }

        // ─── OPPONENT AI ───
        function chooseOpponentMove() {
            const moves = opponent.moves;
            // pick random, but prefer moves with higher power if HP is low
            const weights = moves.map(m => {
                let w = m.power;
                if (getEffectiveness(m.type, player.type) >= 2) w *= 1.8;
                if (getEffectiveness(m.type, player.type) <= 0.5) w *= 0.5;
                return Math.max(1, w);
            });
            const total = weights.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
            let r = Math.random() * total;
            for (let i = 0; i < moves.length; i++) {
                r -= weights[i];
                if (r <= 0) return moves[i];
            }
            return moves[moves.length - 1];
        }

        // ─── BATTLE TURN ───
        async function playerTurn(move) {
            if (animating || !battleActive || !isPlayerTurn) return;
            animating = true;
            isPlayerTurn = false;

            // hide menus
            mainMenu.style.display = 'none';
            moveMenu.style.display = 'none';

            // player attacks
            const result = await executeMove(player, opponent, move, true);

            if (result === 'faint') {
                await onBattleEnd('win');
                animating = false;
                return;
            }

            // check if opponent is still alive
            if (opponent.currentHP <= 0) {
                await onBattleEnd('win');
                animating = false;
                return;
            }

            await delay(300);

            // opponent turn
            const oppMove = chooseOpponentMove();
            const oppResult = await executeMove(opponent, player, oppMove, false);

            if (oppResult === 'faint') {
                await onBattleEnd('lose');
                animating = false;
                return;
            }

            if (player.currentHP <= 0) {
                await onBattleEnd('lose');
                animating = false;
                return;
            }

            // back to menu
            isPlayerTurn = true;
            animating = false;
            showMainMenu();
        }

        async function onBattleEnd(result) {
            battleActive = false;
            const won = result === 'win';
            statusTitle.textContent = won ? '🏆 Victory!' : '💔 Defeat...';
            statusSub.textContent = won ?
                `${player.name} won the battle!` :
                `${player.name} fainted...`;
            statusOverlay.classList.add('active');
            if (won) {
                soundWin();
                updateExp();
            } else {
                soundLose();
            }
        }

        // ─── MENU SYSTEM ───
        function showMainMenu() {
            if (!battleActive) return;
            mainMenu.style.display = 'grid';
            moveMenu.style.display = 'none';
            // enable all main buttons
            document.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
            document.querySelectorAll('.move-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = false);
            // update text
            setText(`What will ${player.name} do?`, true);
        }

        function showMoveMenu() {
            if (!battleActive) return;
            mainMenu.style.display = 'none';
            moveMenu.style.display = 'grid';
            // build move buttons
            moveMenu.innerHTML = '';
            player.moves.forEach((move, idx) => {
                const btn = document.createElement('button');
                btn.className = 'move-btn';
                btn.innerHTML = `
                    <span>${move.name}</span>
                    <span>
                        <span class="move-type type-${move.type}">${move.type}</span>
                        <span class="move-power">${move.power}</span>
                    </span>
                `;
                btn.dataset.index = idx;
                btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    if (animating || !battleActive) return;
                    soundConfirm();
                    playerTurn(move);
                });
                btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => playBeep(500, 0.03, 'sine', 0.03));
                moveMenu.appendChild(btn);
            });
            setText(`Choose a move!`, true);
        }

        // ─── MAIN MENU ACTIONS ───
        document.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn').forEach(btn => {
            btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (animating || !battleActive) return;
                const action = btn.dataset.action;
                soundSelect();
                switch (action) {
                    case 'fight':
                        showMoveMenu();
                        break;
                    case 'bag':
                        setText(`You can't use items in this demo!`, true);
                        playBeep(300, 0.15, 'square', 0.06);
                        break;
                    case 'pokemon':
                        setText(`Can't switch Pokémon right now!`, true);
                        playBeep(300, 0.15, 'square', 0.06);
                        break;
                    case 'run':
                        setText(`Can't escape from a trainer battle!`, true);
                        playBeep(300, 0.15, 'square', 0.06);
                        break;
                }
            });
            btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                if (!btn.disabled) playBeep(500, 0.025, 'sine', 0.02);
            });
        });

        // ─── RESTART ───
        btnRestart.addEventListener('click', () => {
            soundConfirm();
            statusOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            initBattle();
        });

        // ─── INIT BATTLE ───
        function initBattle() {
            // reset state
            player = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(PLAYER_POKEMON));
            opponent = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(OPPONENT_POKEMON));
            player.currentHP = player.maxHP;
            opponent.currentHP = opponent.maxHP;
            isPlayerTurn = true;
            battleActive = true;
            animating = false;
            textQueue = [];
            isTextRunning = false;

            // reset UI
            statusOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            flashOverlay.classList.remove('active');
            particleContainer.innerHTML = '';
            opponentSprite.classList.remove('hit', 'attack-anim');
            playerSprite.classList.remove('hit', 'attack-anim');

            // sprites
            opponentSprite.textContent = opponent.spriteEmoji;
            playerSprite.textContent = player.spriteEmoji;
            opponentName.textContent = opponent.name.toUpperCase();
            playerName.textContent = player.name.toUpperCase();
            opponentHpName.textContent = opponent.name.toUpperCase();
            playerHpName.textContent = player.name.toUpperCase();
            opponentLevel.textContent = opponent.level;
            playerLevel.textContent = player.level;

            updateAllHp(false);
            updateExp();

            // show main menu
            mainMenu.style.display = 'grid';
            moveMenu.style.display = 'none';
            document.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn').forEach(b => b.disabled = false);

            // intro text
            (async () => {
                await setText(`A wild ${opponent.name} appeared!`, true);
                await delay(400);
                await showText(`Go! ${player.name}!`);
                soundConfirm();
                await delay(200);
                setText(`What will ${player.name} do?`, true);
            })();
        }

        // ─── START ───
        initBattle();

        // ─── KEYBOARD SHORTCUTS ───
        document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                // advance text if text is running
                // or press the first available button
                if (!battleActive) return;
                if (animating) return;
                const visibleMoves = moveMenu.style.display === 'grid';
                if (visibleMoves) {
                    const btns = moveMenu.querySelectorAll('.move-btn');
                    if (btns.length > 0) btns[0].click();
                } else {
                    const btns = mainMenu.querySelectorAll('.menu-btn:not(:disabled)');
                    if (btns.length > 0) btns[0].click();
                }
            }
            if (e.key === '1') { const b = moveMenu.querySelector('.move-btn');
                b?.click(); }
            if (e.key === '2') { const b = moveMenu.querySelectorAll('.move-btn')[1];
                b?.click(); }
            if (e.key === '3') { const b = moveMenu.querySelectorAll('.move-btn')[2];
                b?.click(); }
            if (e.key === '4') { const b = moveMenu.querySelectorAll('.move-btn')[3];
                b?.click(); }
        });

        // ─── TOUCH/FALLBACK CLICK FOR TEXT ADVANCE ───
        textBox.addEventListener('click', () => {
            if (!battleActive || animating) return;
            // if text is being typed, do nothing (it auto-advances)
            // otherwise, it's used for showText()
        });

        console.log('🔥 Pokémon Battle — Gotta Catch \'Em All!');
    </script>

</body>
</html>

        /* Menu */
        .menu-overlay {

        }
        .menu-option:hover,
        .menu-option.selected {

            display: grid;

        /* Screen flash */
        .screen-flash {
            position: absolute;

            opacity: 0.7;

        }

        /* Victory/Defeat overlay */
        .result-overlay {
            position: absolute;

            left: 50%;
