            z-index: 95;
            text-align: center;
            pointer-events: none;
            font-family: 'Courier New', 'Consolas', monospace;
        }
        .result-text {
            font-size: 28px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #f8f0d8;
            text-shadow:
                3px 3px 0 #2c1810,
                -1px -1px 0 #2c1810,
                1px -1px 0 #2c1810,
                -1px 1px 0 #2c1810;
            letter-spacing: 2px;
            animation: resultBounce 0.6s ease-out;
            text-transform: uppercase;
        }
        @keyframes resultBounce {
            0% {
                transform: scale(0.3);
                opacity: 0;
            }
            50% {
                transform: scale(1.15);
            }
            100% {
                transform: scale(1);
                opacity: 1;
            }
        }

        /* Restart button */
        .restart-btn {
            position: absolute;
            bottom: 15px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            z-index: 96;
            background: #f8d830;
            border: 3px solid #2c1810;
            border-radius: 8px;
            padding: 10px 24px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-family: 'Courier New', 'Consolas', monospace;
            font-size: 15px;
            font-weight: bold;
            color: #2c1810;
            letter-spacing: 1px;
            text-transform: uppercase;
            box-shadow: 3px 3px 0 #2c1810;
            transition: all 0.15s ease;
            pointer-events: auto;
        }
        .restart-btn:hover {
            background: #fce848;
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-2px);
            box-shadow: 5px 5px 0 #2c1810;
        }
        .restart-btn:active {
            transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(2px);
            box-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #2c1810;
        }

        /* Responsive */
        @media (max-width: 600px) {
            .game-container {
                max-width: 98vw;
                aspect-ratio: 4/3;
                padding: 6px;
                border-radius: 12px;
            }
            .wild-pokemon-sprite {
                font-size: 50px;
            }
            .player-pokemon-sprite {
                font-size: 58px;
            }
            .wild-hp-container {
                top: 5%;
                left: 4%;
                padding: 5px 7px 4px;
                min-width: 100px;
            }
            .wild-hp-container .name {
                font-size: 10px;
            }
            .wild-hp-container .hp-bar-outer {
                width: 80px;
                height: 6px;
            }
            .player-hp-container {
                bottom: 30%;
                right: 4%;
                padding: 5px 7px 4px;
                min-width: 110px;
            }
            .player-hp-container .name {
                font-size: 10px;
            }
            .player-hp-container .hp-bar-outer {
                width: 90px;
                height: 6px;
            }
            .hp-text {
                font-size: 8px;
            }
            .menu-option {
                font-size: 11px;
                padding: 6px 10px;
                min-width: 55px;
            }
            .dialogue-text {
                font-size: 12px;
            }
            .text-box-container {
                padding: 8px 10px;
                min-height: 60px;
            }
            .result-text {
                font-size: 20px;
            }
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>

    <div class="game-container" id="gameContainer">
        <div class="screen" id="screen">
            <!-- Battle Arena -->
            <div class="battle-arena" id="battleArena">
                <!-- Clouds -->
                <div class="cloud cloud1"></div>
                <div class="cloud cloud2"></div>
                <div class="cloud cloud3"></div>
                <!-- Ground -->
                <div class="ground-detail"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>
                <div class="grass-tuft"></div>

                <!-- Wild Bulbasaur -->
                <div class="wild-hp-container" id="wildHpContainer">
                    <span class="name">BULBASAUR</span><span class="level">Lv:22</span>
                    <div class="hp-bar-outer">
                        <div class="hp-bar-inner" id="wildHpBar"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="hp-text" id="wildHpText">HP: 110/110</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Wild Pokémon Sprite -->
                <div class="wild-pokemon-container" id="wildSpriteContainer">
                    <span class="wild-pokemon-sprite" id="wildSprite">🐸</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Player Pikachu -->
                <div class="player-hp-container" id="playerHpContainer">
                    <span class="name">PIKACHU</span><span class="level">Lv:25</span>
                    <div class="hp-bar-outer">
                        <div class="hp-bar-inner" id="playerHpBar"></div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="hp-text" id="playerHpText">HP: 100/100</div>
                </div>

                <!-- Player Pokémon Sprite -->
                <div class="player-pokemon-container" id="playerSpriteContainer">
                    <span class="player-pokemon-sprite" id="playerSprite">🐹</span>
                </div>

                <!-- Screen flash -->
                <div class="screen-flash" id="screenFlash"></div>

                <!-- Result overlay -->
                <div class="result-overlay" id="resultOverlay" style="display:none;">
                    <div class="result-text" id="resultText"></div>
                </div>
                <button class="restart-btn" id="restartBtn" style="display:none;">PLAY AGAIN</button>
            </div>

            <!-- Text Box Area -->
            <div class="text-box-container" id="textBoxContainer">
                <div class="dialogue-text" id="dialogueText"></div>
                <div class="continue-indicator" id="continueIndicator" style="display:none;">▼</div>
            </div>

            <!-- Menu Overlay -->
            <div class="menu-overlay" id="menuOverlay" style="display:none;">
                <div class="menu-grid" id="menuGrid">
                    <!-- Dynamically filled -->
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    </div>

    <script>
        (function() {
            // --- DOM Elements ---
            const dialogueText = document.getElementById('dialogueText');
            const continueIndicator = document.getElementById('continueIndicator');
            const menuOverlay = document.getElementById('menuOverlay');
            const menuGrid = document.getElementById('menuGrid');
            const screenFlash = document.getElementById('screenFlash');
            const wildHpBar = document.getElementById('wildHpBar');
            const playerHpBar = document.getElementById('playerHpBar');
            const wildHpText = document.getElementById('wildHpText');
            const playerHpText = document.getElementById('playerHpText');
            const wildSprite = document.getElementById('wildSprite');
            const playerSprite = document.getElementById('playerSprite');
            const wildSpriteContainer = document.getElementById('wildSpriteContainer');
            const playerSpriteContainer = document.getElementById('playerSpriteContainer');
            const resultOverlay = document.getElementById('resultOverlay');
            const resultText = document.getElementById('resultText');
            const restartBtn = document.getElementById('restartBtn');
            const battleArena = document.getElementById('battleArena');
            const textBoxContainer = document.getElementById('textBoxContainer');

            // --- Game State ---
            const state = {
                playerHP: 100,
                playerMaxHP: 100,
                wildHP: 110,
                wildMaxHP: 110,
                playerAttackMod: 1.0,
                wildParalyzed: false,
                potionUsed: false,
                battleOver: false,
                isPlayerTurn: true,
            };

            // --- Move Definitions ---
            const playerMoves = [
                { name: 'THUNDERBOLT', power: 40, type: 'electric', accuracy: 100, icon: '⚡' },
                { name: 'QUICK ATTACK', power: 25, type: 'normal', accuracy: 100, icon: '💨' },
                { name: 'IRON TAIL', power: 50, type: 'steel', accuracy: 75, icon: '🔩' },
                { name: 'THUNDER WAVE', power: 0, type: 'electric', accuracy: 90, icon: '🌊',
                isStatus: true },
            ];

            const wildMoves = [
                { name: 'VINE WHIP', power: 35, type: 'grass', accuracy: 100 },
                { name: 'TACKLE', power: 30, type: 'normal', accuracy: 100 },
                { name: 'LEECH SEED', power: 15, type: 'grass', accuracy: 90, isDrain: true },
                { name: 'GROWL', power: 0, type: 'normal', accuracy: 100, isStatus: true },
            ];

            // --- Utility Functions ---
            function sleep(ms) {
                return new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, ms));
            }

            function randomInt(min, max) {
                return Math.floor(Math.random() * (max - min + 1)) + min;
            }

            function clamp(val, min, max) {
                return Math.max(min, Math.min(max, val));
            }

            function flashScreen(duration = 100) {
                screenFlash.classList.add('active');
                setTimeout(() => screenFlash.classList.remove('active'), duration);
            }

            async function typeText(text, speed = 40) {
                dialogueText.textContent = '';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                for (let i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
                    dialogueText.textContent += text[i];
                    await sleep(speed);
                }
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'block';
            }

            function updateHPBars() {
                // Player HP bar
                const playerPercent = Math.max(0, (state.playerHP / state.playerMaxHP) * 100);
                playerHpBar.style.width = playerPercent + '%';
                playerHpBar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
                if (playerPercent <= 20) playerHpBar.classList.add('low');
                else if (playerPercent <= 50) playerHpBar.classList.add('mid');
                playerHpText.textContent = `HP: ${Math.max(0,Math.round(state.playerHP))}/${state.playerMaxHP}`;

                // Wild HP bar
                const wildPercent = Math.max(0, (state.wildHP / state.wildMaxHP) * 100);
                wildHpBar.style.width = wildPercent + '%';
                wildHpBar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
                if (wildPercent <= 20) wildHpBar.classList.add('low');
                else if (wildPercent <= 50) wildHpBar.classList.add('mid');
                wildHpText.textContent = `HP: ${Math.max(0,Math.round(state.wildHP))}/${state.wildMaxHP}`;
            }

            function calculateDamage(power, attackerAtk, defenderDef, modifier = 1.0) {
                if (power <= 0) return 0;
                const base = (power * 0.75 + randomInt(0, Math.floor(power * 0.5))) * modifier;
                return Math.max(1, Math.round(base));
            }

            // --- Menu System ---
            let selectedMenuIndex = 0;
            let currentMenuItems = [];

            function showMenu(items, callback) {
                currentMenuItems = items;
                selectedMenuIndex = 0;
                menuGrid.innerHTML = '';
                items.forEach((item, index) => {
                    const btn = document.createElement('div');
                    btn.className = 'menu-option';
                    btn.textContent = (item.icon ? item.icon + ' ' : '') + item.label;
                    btn.dataset.index = index;
                    btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
                        selectedMenuIndex = index;
                        selectMenuItem(callback);
                    });
                    btn.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                        selectedMenuIndex = index;
                        highlightMenu();
                    });
                    menuGrid.appendChild(btn);
                });
                menuOverlay.style.display = 'flex';
                highlightMenu();
                textBoxContainer.style.display = 'none';
            }

            function highlightMenu() {
                const buttons = menuGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-option');
                buttons.forEach((btn, i) => {
                    btn.classList.toggle('selected', i === selectedMenuIndex);
                    const existingArrow = btn.querySelector('.arrow');
                    if (i === selectedMenuIndex && !existingArrow) {
                        const arrow = document.createElement('span');
                        arrow.className = 'arrow';
                        arrow.textContent = '▶';
                        btn.appendChild(arrow);
                    } else if (i !== selectedMenuIndex && existingArrow) {
                        existingArrow.remove();
                    }
                });
            }

            function hideMenu() {
                menuOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                textBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                currentMenuItems = [];
            }

            async function selectMenuItem(callback) {
                const selected = currentMenuItems[selectedMenuIndex];
                hideMenu();
                if (callback) {
                    await callback(selected);
                }
            }

            // --- Battle Actions ---
            async function playerUseMove(move) {
                if (state.battleOver) return;

                // Accuracy check
                if (move.accuracy < 100) {
                    const roll = randomInt(1, 100);
                    if (roll > move.accuracy) {
                        await typeText(`PIKACHU used ${move.name}...`);
                        await sleep(400);
                        await typeText('But it missed!', 50);
                        await sleep(300);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                await typeText(`PIKACHU used ${move.name}!`, 35);
                await sleep(300);

                if (move.isStatus && move.name === 'THUNDER WAVE') {
                    // Status move
                    playerSprite.classList.add('attacking');
                    await sleep(200);
                    playerSprite.classList.remove('attacking');
                    flashScreen(120);
                    wildSprite.classList.add('hit');
                    await sleep(300);
                    wildSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                    state.wildParalyzed = true;
                    await typeText('Wild BULBASAUR is paralyzed!', 40);
                    await sleep(300);
                    await typeText('It may be unable to move!', 40);
                } else if (move.power > 0) {
                    // Damage move
                    const damage = calculateDamage(move.power, 55, 49, state.playerAttackMod);
                    // Animate player attacking
                    playerSprite.classList.add('attacking');
                    await sleep(250);
                    playerSprite.classList.remove('attacking');
                    flashScreen(100);
                    wildSprite.classList.add('hit');
                    await sleep(150);

                    // Apply damage with animated HP drain
                    const oldHP = state.wildHP;
                    state.wildHP = clamp(state.wildHP - damage, 0, state.wildMaxHP);
                    await animateHPDrain('wild', oldHP, state.wildHP);
                    wildSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                    await sleep(200);

                    if (state.wildHP <= 0) {
                        await handleWildFaint();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                await sleep(400);
            }

            async function animateHPDrain(target, fromHP, toHP) {
                const duration = 700;
                const steps = 30;
                const interval = duration / steps;
                const hpDiff = fromHP - toHP;

                for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
                    const currentHP = fromHP - (hpDiff * (i / steps));
                    if (target === 'wild') {
                        const percent = Math.max(0, (currentHP / state.wildMaxHP) * 100);
                        wildHpBar.style.width = percent + '%';
                        wildHpBar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
                        if (percent <= 20) wildHpBar.classList.add('low');
                        else if (percent <= 50) wildHpBar.classList.add('mid');
                        wildHpText.textContent =
                            `HP: ${Math.max(0,Math.round(currentHP))}/${state.wildMaxHP}`;
                    } else {
                        const percent = Math.max(0, (currentHP / state.playerMaxHP) * 100);
                        playerHpBar.style.width = percent + '%';
                        playerHpBar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
                        if (percent <= 20) playerHpBar.classList.add('low');
                        else if (percent <= 50) playerHpBar.classList.add('mid');
                        playerHpText.textContent =
                            `HP: ${Math.max(0,Math.round(currentHP))}/${state.playerMaxHP}`;
                    }
                    await sleep(interval);
                }
                updateHPBars();
            }

            async function handleWildFaint() {
                state.battleOver = true;
                wildSprite.classList.add('fainted');
                await sleep(400);
                wildSpriteContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                await typeText('Wild BULBASAUR fainted!', 40);
                await sleep(500);
                await typeText('PIKACHU gained EXP!', 40);
                await sleep(400);
                showVictory();
            }

            async function handlePlayerFaint() {
                state.battleOver = true;
                playerSprite.classList.add('fainted');
                await sleep(400);
                playerSpriteContainer.style.opacity = '0';
                await typeText('PIKACHU fainted...', 50);
                await sleep(500);
                await typeText('You blacked out!', 50);
                await sleep(400);
                showDefeat();
            }

            async function wildUseMove() {
                if (state.battleOver) return;

                // Check paralysis
                if (state.wildParalyzed) {
                    const paraRoll = randomInt(1, 100);
                    if (paraRoll <= 30) {
                        await typeText('Wild BULBASAUR is paralyzed!', 40);
                        await sleep(300);
                        await typeText('It can\'t move!', 40);
                        await sleep(400);
                        return;
                    }
                }

                const move = wildMoves[randomInt(0, wildMoves.length - 1)];
                await typeText(`Wild BULBASAUR used ${move.name}!`, 35);
                await sleep(300);

                if (move.isStatus && move.name === 'GROWL') {
                    // Growl reduces attack
                    flashScreen(80);
                    playerSprite.classList.add('hit');
                    await sleep(300);
                    playerSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                    state.playerAttackMod = clamp(state.playerAttackMod - 0.15, 0.4, 1.0);
                    await typeText('PIKACHU\'s attack fell!', 40);
                } else if (move.isDrain && move.name === 'LEECH SEED') {
                    const drainAmount = calculateDamage(move.power, 49, 40);
                    flashScreen(100);
                    playerSprite.classList.add('hit');
                    const oldPlayerHP = state.playerHP;
                    state.playerHP = clamp(state.playerHP - drainAmount, 0, state.playerMaxHP);
                    state.wildHP = clamp(state.wildHP + drainAmount, 0, state.wildMaxHP);
                    await animateHPDrain('player', oldPlayerHP, state.playerHP);
                    playerSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                    updateHPBars();
                    await sleep(200);
                    await typeText('Energy was drained!', 40);
                    if (state.playerHP <= 0) {
                        await handlePlayerFaint();
                        return;
                    }
                } else if (move.power > 0) {
                    const damage = calculateDamage(move.power, 49, 40);
                    flashScreen(100);
                    playerSprite.classList.add('hit');
                    const oldPlayerHP = state.playerHP;
                    state.playerHP = clamp(state.playerHP - damage, 0, state.playerMaxHP);
                    await animateHPDrain('player', oldPlayerHP, state.playerHP);
                    playerSprite.classList.remove('hit');
                    if (state.playerHP <= 0) {
                        await handlePlayerFaint();
                        return;
                    }
                }
                await sleep(400);
            }

            function showVictory() {
                resultText.textContent = 'VICTORY!';
                resultOverlay.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.textContent = 'PLAY AGAIN';
                hideMenu();
                dialogueText.textContent = 'Congratulations! You won the battle!';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
            }

            function showDefeat() {
                resultText.textContent = 'DEFEAT...';
                resultOverlay.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.textContent = 'TRY AGAIN';
                hideMenu();
                dialogueText.textContent = 'You were defeated... Try again!';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
            }

            function showRanAway() {
                resultText.textContent = 'GOT AWAY!';
                resultOverlay.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.style.display = 'block';
                restartBtn.textContent = 'NEW BATTLE';
                hideMenu();
                dialogueText.textContent = 'You got away safely!';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                state.battleOver = true;
            }

            // --- Main Battle Flow ---
            async function showMainMenu() {
                if (state.battleOver) return;
                state.isPlayerTurn = true;
                const items = [
                    { label: 'FIGHT', icon: '⚔️', action: 'fight' },
                    { label: 'BAG', icon: '🎒', action: 'bag' },
                    { label: 'POKÉMON', icon: '🐾', action: 'pokemon' },
                    { label: 'RUN', icon: '🏃', action: 'run' },
                ];
                await new Promise(resolve => {
                    showMenu(items, async (selected) => {
                        if (selected.action === 'fight') {
                            await showMoveMenu();
                        } else if (selected.action === 'bag') {
                            await useBag();
                        } else if (selected.action === 'pokemon') {
                            await checkPokemon();
                        } else if (selected.action === 'run') {
                            await attemptRun();
                        }
                        resolve();
                    });
                });
            }

            async function showMoveMenu() {
                const items = playerMoves.map(m => ({
                    label: m.name,
                    icon: m.icon,
                    move: m,
                    action: 'move',
                }));
                items.push({ label: 'BACK', icon: '↩️', action: 'back' });

                await new Promise(resolve => {
                    showMenu(items, async (selected) => {
                        if (selected.action === 'back') {
                            resolve();
                            return;
                        }
                        if (selected.action === 'move') {
                            await playerUseMove(selected.move);
                            if (!state.battleOver) {
                                await sleep(500);
                                await wildUseMove();
                                if (!state.battleOver) {
                                    await sleep(300);
                                    await typeText('What will PIKACHU do?', 35);
                                    await sleep(400);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        resolve();
                    });
                });
            }

            async function useBag() {
                if (state.potionUsed) {
                    await typeText('No items left in the bag...', 40);
                    await sleep(500);
                    return;
                }
                state.potionUsed = true;
                const healAmount = 30;
                const oldHP = state.playerHP;
                state.playerHP = clamp(state.playerHP + healAmount, 0, state.playerMaxHP);
                const actualHeal = state.playerHP - oldHP;
                await typeText('You used a POTION!', 40);
                await sleep(300);
                // Animate HP increase
                const duration = 500;
                const steps = 20;
                for (let i = 0; i <= steps; i++) {
                    const cur = oldHP + (actualHeal * (i / steps));
                    const percent = (cur / state.playerMaxHP) * 100;
                    playerHpBar.style.width = percent + '%';
                    playerHpBar.classList.remove('low', 'mid');
                    if (percent <= 20) playerHpBar.classList.add('low');
                    else if (percent <= 50) playerHpBar.classList.add('mid');
                    playerHpText.textContent = `HP: ${Math.round(cur)}/${state.playerMaxHP}`;
                    await sleep(duration / steps);
                }
                updateHPBars();
                await typeText(`PIKACHU recovered ${Math.round(actualHeal)} HP!`, 40);
                await sleep(400);
                // Enemy attacks after using item
                if (!state.battleOver) {
                    await wildUseMove();
                    if (!state.battleOver) {
                        await sleep(300);
                        await typeText('What will PIKACHU do?', 35);
                        await sleep(400);
                    }
                }
            }

            async function checkPokemon() {
                await typeText('PIKACHU is already in battle!', 40);
                await sleep(500);
            }

            async function attemptRun() {
                await typeText('You tried to run away...', 40);
                await sleep(400);
                const successRoll = randomInt(1, 100);
                if (successRoll <= 75) {
                    await typeText('Got away safely!', 40);
                    await sleep(300);
                    showRanAway();
                } else {
                    await typeText('Can\'t escape!', 40);
                    await sleep(300);
                    if (!state.battleOver) {
                        await wildUseMove();
                        if (!state.battleOver) {
                            await sleep(300);
                            await typeText('What will PIKACHU do?', 35);
                            await sleep(400);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }

            // --- Keyboard Controls ---
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (state.battleOver && e.key === 'Enter') {
                    restartBattle();
                    return;
                }
                if (menuOverlay.style.display === 'flex' && currentMenuItems.length > 0) {
                    const cols = 2;
                    const rows = Math.ceil(currentMenuItems.length / cols);
                    let row = Math.floor(selectedMenuIndex / cols);
                    let col = selectedMenuIndex % cols;

                    switch (e.key) {
                        case 'ArrowUp':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            row = (row - 1 + rows) % rows;
                            selectedMenuIndex = row * cols + Math.min(col, cols - 1);
                            if (selectedMenuIndex >= currentMenuItems.length)
                                selectedMenuIndex = currentMenuItems.length - 1;
                            highlightMenu();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowDown':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            row = (row + 1) % rows;
                            selectedMenuIndex = row * cols + Math.min(col, cols - 1);
                            if (selectedMenuIndex >= currentMenuItems.length)
                                selectedMenuIndex = currentMenuItems.length - 1;
                            highlightMenu();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowLeft':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            col = (col - 1 + cols) % cols;
                            selectedMenuIndex = row * cols + col;
                            if (selectedMenuIndex >= currentMenuItems.length)
                                selectedMenuIndex = currentMenuItems.length - 1;
                            highlightMenu();
                            break;
                        case 'ArrowRight':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            col = (col + 1) % cols;
                            selectedMenuIndex = row * cols + col;
                            if (selectedMenuIndex >= currentMenuItems.length)
                                selectedMenuIndex = currentMenuItems.length - 1;
                            highlightMenu();
                            break;
                        case 'Enter':
                        case ' ':
                            e.preventDefault();
                            selectMenuItem(async (selected) => {
                                if (selected.action === 'fight') {
                                    await showMoveMenu();
                                } else if (selected.action === 'bag') {
                                    await useBag();
                                } else if (selected.action === 'pokemon') {
                                    await checkPokemon();
                                } else if (selected.action === 'run') {
                                    await attemptRun();
                                } else if (selected.action === 'back') {
                                    // Do nothing, will re-show main menu
                                } else if (selected.action === 'move') {
                                    await playerUseMove(selected.move);
                                    if (!state.battleOver) {
                                        await sleep(500);
                                        await wildUseMove();
                                        if (!state.battleOver) {
                                            await sleep(300);
                                            await typeText('What will PIKACHU do?', 35);
                                            await sleep(400);
                                        }
                                    }
                                }
                                if (!state.battleOver) {
                                    await showMainMenu();
                                }
                            });
                            break;
                    }
                }
            });

            // --- Restart ---
            function restartBattle() {
                state.playerHP = state.playerMaxHP;
                state.wildHP = state.wildMaxHP;
                state.playerAttackMod = 1.0;
                state.wildParalyzed = false;
                state.potionUsed = false;
                state.battleOver = false;
                state.isPlayerTurn = true;
                resultOverlay.style.display = 'none';
                restartBtn.style.display = 'none';
                wildSpriteContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                playerSpriteContainer.style.opacity = '1';
                wildSprite.classList.remove('fainted', 'hit');
                playerSprite.classList.remove('fainted', 'hit', 'attacking');
                wildSpriteContainer.style.animation = 'none';
                playerSpriteContainer.style.animation = 'none';
                void wildSpriteContainer.offsetWidth;
                void playerSpriteContainer.offsetWidth;
                wildSpriteContainer.style.animation = 'enemyIdle 2.5s ease-in-out infinite';
                playerSpriteContainer.style.animation = 'playerIdle 2.8s ease-in-out infinite';
                updateHPBars();
                hideMenu();
                dialogueText.textContent = '';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                textBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                startBattle();
            }

            restartBtn.addEventListener('click', restartBattle);

            // --- Start Battle ---
            async function startBattle() {
                updateHPBars();
                hideMenu();
                textBoxContainer.style.display = 'flex';
                dialogueText.textContent = '';
                continueIndicator.style.display = 'none';
                await sleep(300);
                await typeText('Wild BULBASAUR appeared!', 40);
                await sleep(500);
                await typeText('Go! PIKACHU!', 40);
                await sleep(500);
                await typeText('What will PIKACHU do?', 35);
                await sleep(300);
                if (!state.battleOver) {
                    await showMainMenu();
                }
            }

            // --- Initialize ---
            updateHPBars();
            startBattle();

            console.log('🐹⚡ Pokémon Battle ready! Use arrow keys + Enter or click to play.');
            console.log('Your PIKACHU (Lv.25) vs Wild BULBASAUR (Lv.22)');
            console.log('Moves: Thunderbolt | Quick Attack | Iron Tail | Thunder Wave');
            console.log('Bag has 1 Potion. Good luck!');
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

question: pokemon-battle-ui
prompt: Recreate a Pokémon battle UI — make it interactive, nostalgic, and fun. Stick to the spirit of a classic battle, but feel free to get creative if you want. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>Pokémon Battle</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Space+Mono:wght@400;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root {
  --bg: #0d1117;
  --bg-panel: #161b22;
  --bg-panel-hover: #1f242d;
  --border: #30363d;
  --border-bright: #484f58;
  --text: #e6edf3;
  --text-dim: #8b949e;
  --text-dark: #0d1117;
  --accent: #ffcb05;
  --accent-dim: #cc9900;
  --red: #f85149;
  --red-dim: #a03028;
  --green: #3fb950;
  --green-dim: #2a8038;
  --blue: #58a6ff;
  --purple: #a371f7;
  --orange: #d18616;
  --pink: #f778ba;
  --cyan: #39c5cf;
  --font-ui: 'Press Start 2P', cursive;
  --font-mono: 'Space Mono', monospace;
  --shadow: 0 4px 24px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
  --shadow-lg: 0 8px 48px rgba(0,0,0,0.7);
  --radius: 4px;
  --transition: 120ms ease-out;
}

* { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  *, *::before, *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
  }
}

html, body { height: 100%; overflow: hidden; }

body {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  background: var(--bg);
  color: var(--text);
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  min-height: 100vh;
  position: relative;
}

body::before {
  content: '';
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background-image: 
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 20% 20%, rgba(255,203,5,0.08) 0%, transparent 50%),
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 80% 80%, rgba(88,166,255,0.06) 0%, transparent 50%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(0deg, transparent, transparent 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 4px);
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 0;
}

#battle {
  width: 100%;
  max-width: 960px;
  height: 100%;
  max-height: 640px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-rows: 1fr auto;
  gap: 8px;
  padding: 12px;
  position: relative;
  z-index: 1;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #battle { padding: 8px; gap: 6px; max-height: 100vh; }
  body { align-items: start; }
}

/* === SCENE === */
#scene {
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1a1f2e 0%, #0d1117 100%);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  overflow: hidden;
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  align-items: end;
  padding: 24px 16px 16px;
  min-height: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #scene { grid-template-columns: 1fr; grid-template-rows: 1fr 1fr; padding: 16px 12px; }
}

.scene-bg {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: 
    radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 100%, rgba(255,203,5,0.1) 0%, transparent 60%),
    repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, transparent, transparent 8px, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 8px, rgba(255,255,255,0.01) 16px);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.platform {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 60px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, #1c2530 0%, #12181f 100%);
  border-top: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
  pointer-events: none;
}

.platform::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 4px;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent), var(--blue), var(--accent));
  background-size: 200% 100%;
  animation: shimmer 3s linear infinite;
}

@keyframes shimmer {
  0% { background-position: 200% 0; }
  100% { background-position: -200% 0; }
}

/* === POKEMON === */
.pokemon-slot {
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 8px;
  z-index: 2;
  position: relative;
}

.pokemon-slot.player { align-items: flex-start; }
.pokemon-slot.opponent { align-items: flex-end; }

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .pokemon-slot.player { align-items: center; }
  .pokemon-slot.opponent { align-items: center; }
}

.pokemon-sprite {
  width: 120px;
  height: 120px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  image-rendering: crisp-edges;
  filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5));
  transition: transform var(--transition), filter var(--transition);
}

.pokemon-slot.player .pokemon-sprite { transform: scaleX(1); }
.pokemon-slot.opponent .pokemon-sprite { transform: scaleX(-1); }

.pokemon-sprite.idle { animation: idle-bounce 2.5s ease-in-out infinite; }
.pokemon-sprite.attacking { animation: attack-lunge 0.4s ease-out; }
.pokemon-sprite.hit { animation: hit-flash 0.3s ease-out; }
.pokemon-sprite.fainted { animation: faint-fall 0.6s ease-in forwards; }

@keyframes idle-bounce {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scaleX(1); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-4px) scaleX(1); }
}
.pokemon-slot.opponent .pokemon-sprite.idle {
  animation: idle-bounce-op 2.5s ease-in-out infinite;
}
@keyframes idle-bounce-op {
  0%, 100% { transform: translateY(0) scaleX(-1); }
  50% { transform: translateY(-4px) scaleX(-1); }
}

@keyframes attack-lunge {
  0% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(1); }
  30% { transform: translateX(20px) scaleX(1); }
  60% { transform: translateX(-10px) scaleX(1); }
  100% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(1); }
}
.pokemon-slot.opponent .pokemon-sprite.attacking {
  animation: attack-lunge-op 0.4s ease-out;
}
@keyframes attack-lunge-op {
  0% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1); }
  30% { transform: translateX(-20px) scaleX(-1); }
  60% { transform: translateX(10px) scaleX(-1); }
  100% { transform: translateX(0) scaleX(-1); }
}

@keyframes hit-flash {
  0%, 100% { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) brightness(1); }
  25% { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) brightness(1.8) saturate(0); }
  50% { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) brightness(1); }
  75% { filter: drop-shadow(0 8px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.5)) brightness(1.8) saturate(0); }
}

@keyframes faint-fall {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scaleX(1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(60px) rotate(-30deg) scaleX(1); opacity: 0; }
}
.pokemon-slot.opponent .pokemon-sprite.fainted {
  animation: faint-fall-op 0.6s ease-in forwards;
}
@keyframes faint-fall-op {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) rotate(0deg) scaleX(-1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(60px) rotate(30deg) scaleX(-1); opacity: 0; }
}

/* HP Bar */
.hp-bar-container {
  width: 180px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .hp-bar-container { width: 100%; max-width: 220px; }
}

.hp-bar-header {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  align-items: baseline;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 7px;
  line-height: 1;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.hp-name { color: var(--text); }
.hp-level { color: var(--text-dim); }

.hp-bar-track {
  height: 10px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
  overflow: hidden;
  position: relative;
  box-shadow: inset 0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
}

.hp-bar-fill {
  height: 100%;
  border-radius: 1px;
  transition: width 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.25, 0.46, 0.45, 0.94), background 0.3s ease;
  position: relative;
  background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--green), #5fd66a);
}

.hp-bar-fill.low { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--orange), #e6a72a); }
.hp-bar-fill.critical { background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--red), #ff7b72); animation: pulse-critical 1s ease-in-out infinite; }

@keyframes pulse-critical {
  0%, 100% { opacity: 1; }
  50% { opacity: 0.6; }
}

.hp-text {
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 6px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-align: right;
}

/* Status icons */
.status-icons {
  display: flex;
  gap: 3px;
  margin-top: 2px;
  height: 10px;
}

.status-icon {
  width: 10px;
  height: 10px;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 6px;
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 2px;
}

/* === ACTION PANEL === */
#action-panel {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
  overflow: hidden;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  min-height: 160px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #action-panel { grid-template-columns: 1fr; min-height: auto; }
}

/* Message Log */
#message-log {
  grid-column: 1 / -1;
  padding: 12px 16px;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 10px;
  line-height: 1.6;
  color: var(--text);
  overflow-y: auto;
  max-height: 140px;
  background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(0,0,0,0.2), transparent);
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column-reverse;
  gap: 6px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #message-log { max-height: 120px; font-size: 9px; padding: 10px 12px; }
}

.msg {
  opacity: 0;
  transform: translateY(10px);
  animation: msg-in 0.3s ease-out forwards;
  white-space: pre-wrap;
  word-break: break-word;
}

@keyframes msg-in {
  to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
}

.msg.system { color: var(--accent); }
.msg.damage { color: var(--red); }
.msg.heal { color: var(--green); }
.msg.effective { color: var(--green); text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green); }
.msg.not-effective { color: var(--orange); }
.msg.immune { color: var(--text-dim); }
.msg.critical { color: var(--accent); text-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--accent); }

/* Move Menu */
#move-menu {
  padding: 12px;
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr;
  gap: 8px;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #move-menu { grid-template-columns: 1fr; padding: 10px; gap: 6px; }
}

.move-btn {
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 10px 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 9px;
  color: var(--text);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  gap: 4px;
  transition: all var(--transition);
  position: relative;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.move-btn::before {
  content: '';
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  background: linear-gradient(135deg, transparent 40%, rgba(255,255,255,0.05) 50%, transparent 60%);
  transform: translateX(-100%);
  transition: transform 0.4s ease;
}

.move-btn:hover:not(:disabled):not(.disabled),
.move-btn:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--accent);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,203,5,0.3), inset 0 0 20px rgba(255,203,5,0.1);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.move-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.move-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); }

.move-btn:hover::before { transform: translateX(100%); }

.move-btn:disabled,
.move-btn.disabled {
  opacity: 0.4;
  cursor: not-allowed;
  border-color: var(--border);
}

.move-name { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; }
.move-type {
  font-size: 6px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  border-radius: 2px;
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.move-pp {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: space-between;
  font-size: 6px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
}

.move-pp.current { color: var(--accent); }

/* Type colors */
.type-normal { background: #a8a878; border-color: #888858; color: #333; }
.type-fire { background: #f08030; border-color: #d06010; color: #fff; }
.type-water { background: #6890f0; border-color: #4870d0; color: #fff; }
.type-electric { background: #f8d030; border-color: #d8b010; color: #333; }
.type-grass { background: #78c850; border-color: #58a830; color: #fff; }
.type-ice { background: #98d8d8; border-color: #78b8b8; color: #333; }
.type-fighting { background: #c03028; border-color: #a01008; color: #fff; }
.type-poison { background: #a040a0; border-color: #802080; color: #fff; }
.type-ground { background: #e0c068; border-color: #c0a048; color: #333; }
.type-flying { background: #a890f0; border-color: #8870d0; color: #fff; }
.type-psychic { background: #f85888; border-color: #d83868; color: #fff; }
.type-bug { background: #a8b820; border-color: #889800; color: #fff; }
.type-rock { background: #b8a038; border-color: #988018; color: #fff; }
.type-ghost { background: #705898; border-color: #503878; color: #fff; }
.type-dragon { background: #7038f8; border-color: #5018d8; color: #fff; }
.type-dark { background: #705848; border-color: #503828; color: #fff; }
.type-steel { background: #b8b8d0; border-color: #9898b0; color: #333; }
.type-fairy { background: #ee99ac; border-color: #cc7788; color: #333; }

/* Info Panel */
#info-panel {
  padding: 12px;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  justify-content: space-between;
  border-left: 1px solid var(--border);
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  #info-panel { border-left: none; border-top: 1px solid var(--border); padding: 10px; }
}

.party {
  display: flex;
  gap: 4px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.party-mon {
  width: 32px;
  height: 32px;
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: 3px;
  background: var(--bg);
  position: relative;
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition);
}

.party-mon:hover { border-color: var(--accent); transform: scale(1.1); z-index: 1; }
.party-mon.active { border-color: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 8px var(--green); }
.party-mon.fainted { opacity: 0.3; border-color: var(--red); background: repeating-linear-gradient(45deg, var(--bg), var(--bg) 4px, var(--red-dim) 4px, var(--red-dim) 8px); }
.party-mon.status { border-color: var(--orange); }

.party-mon .hp-mini {
  position: absolute;
  bottom: 0;
  left: 0;
  right: 0;
  height: 3px;
  background: var(--green);
  border-radius: 0 0 1px 1px;
}

.party-mon.fainted .hp-mini { background: var(--red); }

/* Battle Controls */
.battle-controls {
  display: flex;
  gap: 8px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
}

.control-btn {
  flex: 1;
  min-width: 80px;
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 2px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  padding: 10px;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 8px;
  color: var(--text);
  cursor: pointer;
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 3px;
  transition: all var(--transition);
}

.control-btn:hover:not(:disabled),
.control-btn:focus-visible {
  border-color: var(--blue);
  box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(88,166,255,0.3);
  transform: translateY(-1px);
}

.control-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.control-btn:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px) scale(0.98); }
.control-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.4; cursor: not-allowed; }

.control-btn.primary { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
.control-btn.primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(255,203,5,0.1); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(255,203,5,0.4); }
.control-btn.danger { border-color: var(--red); color: var(--red); }
.control-btn.danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: rgba(248,81,73,0.1); box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(248,81,73,0.4); }

/* Particles */
#particles {
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 10;
  overflow: hidden;
}

.particle {
  position: absolute;
  width: 6px;
  height: 6px;
  border-radius: 50%;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  image-rendering: pixelated;
}

.particle.spark { background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent); }
.particle.fire { background: var(--orange); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--orange); }
.particle.water { background: var(--blue); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--blue); }
.particle.grass { background: var(--green); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--green); }
.particle.electric { background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 60% 35%, 100% 35%, 70% 60%, 80% 100%, 50% 75%, 20% 100%, 30% 60%, 0% 35%, 40% 35%); }
.particle.psychic { background: var(--pink); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--pink); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 61% 35%, 98% 35%, 68% 57%, 79% 91%, 50% 70%, 21% 91%, 32% 57%, 2% 35%, 39% 35%); }
.particle.rock { background: #b8a038; box-shadow: 0 0 4px #988018; border-radius: 2px; }
.particle.ghost { background: var(--purple); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--purple); border-radius: 50% 50% 50% 50% / 60% 60% 40% 40%; }
.particle.dragon { background: var(--purple); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--purple); clip-path: polygon(50% 0%, 100% 25%, 100% 75%, 50% 100%, 0% 75%, 0% 25%); }
.particle.normal { background: var(--text-dim); box-shadow: 0 0 4px var(--text-dim); }

/* Damage Numbers */
.damage-number {
  position: absolute;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 14px;
  font-weight: bold;
  color: var(--red);
  text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #000, -1px -1px 0 #000, 1px -1px 0 #000, -1px 1px 0 #000;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 15;
  animation: damage-pop 0.8s ease-out forwards;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
}

.damage-number.critical { color: var(--accent); font-size: 16px; text-shadow: 1px 1px 0 #000, -1px -1px 0 #000, 1px -1px 0 #000, -1px 1px 0 #000, 0 0 8px var(--accent); }
.damage-number.heal { color: var(--green); }

@keyframes damage-pop {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
  15% { transform: translateY(-10px) scale(1.2); opacity: 1; }
  50% { transform: translateY(-30px) scale(1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-50px) scale(0.8); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Effectiveness popup */
.effectiveness-popup {
  position: absolute;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 8px;
  font-weight: bold;
  padding: 2px 6px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 15;
  animation: eff-pop 0.6s ease-out forwards;
  will-change: transform, opacity;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}

.effectiveness-popup.super { background: var(--green); color: #000; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--green); }
.effectiveness-popup.not { background: var(--orange); color: #000; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--orange); }
.effectiveness-popup.immune { background: var(--text-dim); color: #000; }
.effectiveness-popup.critical { background: var(--accent); color: #000; box-shadow: 0 0 10px var(--accent); }

@keyframes eff-pop {
  0% { transform: translateY(0) scale(0.5); opacity: 0; }
  20% { transform: translateY(-8px) scale(1.1); opacity: 1; }
  100% { transform: translateY(-25px) scale(1); opacity: 0; }
}

/* Screen flash */
.screen-flash {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: white;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  z-index: 100;
  animation: flash 0.15s ease-out;
}

@keyframes flash {
  0% { opacity: 0.4; }
  100% { opacity: 0; }
}

/* Victory/Defeat Overlay */
.overlay {
  position: fixed;
  inset: 0;
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.9);
  display: flex;
  flex-direction: column;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  z-index: 200;
  opacity: 0;
  pointer-events: none;
  transition: opacity 0.3s ease;
}

.overlay.visible { opacity: 1; pointer-events: auto; }

.overlay-title {
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: clamp(16px, 5vw, 28px);
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 24px;
  text-shadow: 2px 2px 0 #000, 0 0 20px currentColor;
  animation: title-pop 0.6s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) forwards;
  opacity: 0;
  transform: scale(0.5);
}

.overlay-title.victory { color: var(--accent); }
.overlay-title.defeat { color: var(--red); }

@keyframes title-pop {
  0% { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.5); }
  60% { transform: scale(1.1); }
  100% { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
}

.overlay-stats {
  font-family: var(--font-mono);
  font-size: 14px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  text-align: center;
  margin-bottom: 32px;
  opacity: 0;
  animation: fade-in 0.5s ease 0.4s forwards;
}

@keyframes fade-in { to { opacity: 1; } }

.overlay-btn {
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 2px solid var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent);
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 10px;
  padding: 14px 32px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: all var(--transition);
  opacity: 0;
  animation: fade-in 0.5s ease 0.6s forwards;
}

.overlay-btn:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--text-dark); box-shadow: 0 0 20px var(--accent); }
.overlay-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px var(--accent), 0 0 20px var(--accent); }

/* Hidden utility */
.hidden { display: none !important; }

/* Keyboard hint */
.kbd-hint {
  position: fixed;
  bottom: 12px;
  right: 12px;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);
  font-size: 7px;
  color: var(--text-dim);
  background: var(--bg-panel);
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: var(--radius);
  display: flex;
  gap: 16px;
  flex-wrap: wrap;
  max-width: 300px;
  z-index: 50;
}

@media (max-width: 600px) {
  .kbd-hint { bottom: 8px; right: 8px; left: 8px; font-size: 6px; padding: 6px 8px; gap: 8px; justify-content: center; }
}

.kbd-hint kbd {
  background: var(--bg);
  border: 1px solid var(--border-bright);
  border-radius: 2px;
  padding: 1px 5px;
  font-family: var(--font-ui);

/* Scrollbar */

#message-log::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg); }
#message-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--border-bright); border-radius: 3px; }
#message-log::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb:hover { background: var(--accent); }

// ============================================
// AUDIO ENGINE (Web Audio API)
// ============================================

class AudioEngine {
  constructor() {
    this.ctx = null;
    this.enabled = false;
    this.masterGain = null;
  }
  
  init() {
    if (this.ctx) return;
    this.ctx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
    this.masterGain = this.ctx.createGain();
    this.masterGain.gain.value = 0.3;
    this.masterGain.connect(this.ctx.destination);
    this.enabled = true;
  }
  
  resume() {
    if (this.ctx && this.ctx.state === 'suspended') this.ctx.resume();
  }
  
  playTone(freq, duration, type = 'square', volume = 0.1, startTime = 0) {
    if (!this.enabled || !this.ctx) return;
    const now = this.ctx.currentTime + startTime;
    const osc = this.ctx.createOscillator();
    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
    osc.type = type;
    osc.frequency.value = freq;
    gain.gain.value = volume;
    osc.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.masterGain);
    osc.start(now);
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, now + duration);
    osc.stop(now + duration);
  }
  
  playNoise(duration, volume = 0.05) {
    if (!this.enabled || !this.ctx) return;
    const bufferSize = this.ctx.sampleRate * duration;
    const buffer = this.ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, this.ctx.sampleRate);
    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) data[i] = Math.random() * 2 - 1;
    const source = this.ctx.createBufferSource();
    const gain = this.ctx.createGain();
    source.buffer = buffer;
    gain.gain.value = volume;
    source.connect(gain);
    gain.connect(this.masterGain);
    source.start();
    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, this.ctx.currentTime + duration);
  }
  
  // Sound effects
  beep(pitch = 440, dur = 0.1) { this.playTone(pitch, dur, 'square', 0.08); }
  boop() { this.playTone(660, 0.08, 'sine', 0.1); }
  hit() { 
    this.playTone(220, 0.1, 'sawtooth', 0.15);
    this.playNoise(0.1, 0.1);
  }
  heal() {
    for (let i = 0; i < 3; i++) this.playTone(440 * Math.pow(1.25, i), 0.15, 'sine', 0.08, i * 0.08);
  }
  select() { this.playTone(880, 0.05, 'square', 0.06); }
  cancel() { this.playTone(330, 0.1, 'square', 0.06); }
  levelUp() {
    [523, 659, 784, 1047].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.15, 'square', 0.08, i * 0.08));
  }
  faint() {
    [330, 262, 220, 165].forEach((f, i) => this.playTone(f, 0.2, 'sawtooth', 0.1, i * 0.15));
  }
  critical() {
    this.playTone(1000, 0.05, 'square', 0.1);

        :root {

            --hp-red: #d00000;
            --hp-bg: #585858;

        }
        html,

            width: 100%;
            height: 100%;
            background: #0a0a14;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            font-family: var(--font);
            image-rendering: pixelated;
            image-rendering: crisp-edges;
            overflow: hidden;
            user-select: none;
            -webkit-user-select: none;
            -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
        }
        .game-container {
            position: relative;
            width: min(860px, 96vw);
            aspect-ratio: 5/3.6;
            max-height: 96vh;
            background: #181820;
            border: 8px solid #2a2a3a;
            border-radius: 12px;
            box-shadow: 0 0 60px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.8), 0 0 24px rgba(80, 80, 140, 0.3), inset 0 0 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.6);
            overflow: hidden;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            cursor: default;
        }
        .battle-view {
            position: relative;
            flex: 1;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #88ccee 0%, #aaddff 20%, #88cc88 45%, #66aa66 55%, #559955 70%, #448844 100%);
            overflow: hidden;
            border-bottom: 4px solid #2a2a3a;
            min-height: 0;
        }
        .battle-view.shake {
            animation: screenShake 0.35s ease-out;
        }
        @keyframes screenShake {
            0% {
                transform: translate(0, 0);
            }
            15% {
                transform: translate(-6px, 3px);
            }
            30% {
                transform: translate(5px, -4px);
            }
            45% {
                transform: translate(-4px, -2px);
            }
            60% {
                transform: translate(3px, 4px);
            }
            75% {
                transform: translate(-2px, 1px);
            }
            90% {
                transform: translate(1px, -1px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translate(0, 0);
            }
        }
        .bg-decor {
            position: absolute;
            pointer-events: none;
            image-rendering: pixelated;
        }
        .bg-cloud {
            position: absolute;
            background: #ffffffcc;
            border-radius: 50%;
            pointer-events: none;
        }
        .bg-cloud-1 {
            width: 80px;
            height: 24px;
            top: 6%;
            left: 8%;
            animation: cloudDrift 22s linear infinite;
        }
        .bg-cloud-2 {
            width: 100px;
            height: 28px;
            top: 12%;
            left: 55%;
            animation: cloudDrift 30s linear infinite reverse;
        }
        .bg-cloud-3 {
            width: 60px;
            height: 18px;
            top: 4%;
            left: 35%;
            animation: cloudDrift 26s linear infinite;
        }
        @keyframes cloudDrift {
            0% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }
            50% {
                transform: translateX(120px);
            }
            100% {
                transform: translateX(0);
            }

        }
        .enemy-sprite-wrap.hit-flash {

        }
        .enemy-sprite-wrap.faint-anim {

    <script>
        (function() {
            // ============ SOUND ENGINE ============
            const AudioCtx = window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext;
            let audioCtx = null;

            function ensureAudio() {
                if (!audioCtx) {
                    audioCtx = new AudioCtx();
                }
                if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') {
                    audioCtx.resume();
                }
                return audioCtx;
            }

            function playTone(freq, duration, type = 'square', vol = 0.15) {
                try {
                    const ctx = ensureAudio();
                    const osc = ctx.createOscillator();
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    osc.type = type;
                    osc.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(vol, ctx.currentTime);
                    gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, ctx.currentTime + duration);
                    osc.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    osc.start(ctx.currentTime);
                    osc.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration);
                } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
            }

            function playNoiseHit(duration = 0.15, vol = 0.2) {
                try {
                    const ctx = ensureAudio();
                    const bufferSize = ctx.sampleRate * duration;
                    const buffer = ctx.createBuffer(1, bufferSize, ctx.sampleRate);
                    const data = buffer.getChannelData(0);
                    for (let i = 0; i < bufferSize; i++) {
                        data[i] = (Math.random() * 2 - 1) * vol * (1 - i / bufferSize);
                    }
                    const source = ctx.createBufferSource();
                    source.buffer = buffer;
                    const gain = ctx.createGain();
                    gain.gain.value = 1;
                    source.connect(gain);
                    gain.connect(ctx.destination);
                    source.start();
                    source.stop(ctx.currentTime + duration);
                } catch (e) { /* silent */ }
            }

            function sndMenuMove() { playTone(880, 0.06, 'square', 0.1); }

            function sndMenuSelect() { playTone(660, 0.08, 'square', 0.12);
                playTone(990, 0.06, 'square', 0.08); }

            function sndTextTick() { playTone(1200, 0.015, 'square', 0.025); }

            function sndMoveUsed() { playTone(520, 0.12, 'square', 0.1);
                playTone(780, 0.08, 'square', 0.06); }

            function sndHit() { playNoiseHit(0.2, 0.25);
                playTone(180, 0.15, 'triangle', 0.15); }

            function sndSuperEffective() { playNoiseHit(0.25, 0.3);
                playTone(250, 0.18, 'square', 0.12);
                playTone(400, 0.1, 'square', 0.1); }

            function sndNotVeryEffective() { playTone(200, 0.08, 'triangle', 0.06);
                playTone(150, 0.12, 'triangle', 0.04); }

            function sndCritical() { playNoiseHit(0.3, 0.35);
                playTone(350, 0.2, 'square', 0.15);
                playTone(500, 0.15, 'square', 0.1); }

            function sndHpDrain() { playTone(300, 0.03, 'square', 0.04); }

            function sndFaint() { playTone(400, 0.2, 'triangle', 0.1);
                playTone(200, 0.3, 'triangle', 0.08);
                playTone(100, 0.4, 'triangle', 0.06); }

            function sndVictory() {
                playTone(523, 0.12, 'square', 0.12);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(659, 0.12, 'square', 0.12), 120);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(784, 0.12, 'square', 0.12), 240);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(1046, 0.3, 'square', 0.14), 360);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(784, 0.2, 'square', 0.12), 620);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(1046, 0.5, 'square', 0.14), 820);
            }

            function sndDefeat() {
                playTone(400, 0.15, 'square', 0.1);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(300, 0.15, 'square', 0.1), 160);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(200, 0.2, 'square', 0.1), 320);
                setTimeout(() => playTone(100, 0.4, 'triangle', 0.08), 500);
            }

            function sndRun() { playTone(600, 0.1, 'square', 0.08);
                playTone(800, 0.1, 'square', 0.08);
                playTone(1000, 0.1, 'square', 0.08); }

            function sndExpGain() {
                for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) { setTimeout(() => playTone(500 + i * 100, 0.05, 'square', 0.08), i * 60); }
            }

            // ============ TYPE CHART (Gen 1 style) ============
            const typeChart = {
                fire: { grass: 2, ice: 2, bug: 2, water: 0.5, fire: 0.5, rock: 0.5, dragon: 0.5 },
                water: { fire: 2, ground: 2, rock: 2, water: 0.5, grass: 0.5, dragon: 0.5 },
                dragon: { dragon: 2 },
                ground: { fire: 2, electric: 2, poison: 2, rock: 2, grass: 0.5, bug: 0.5 },
                flying: { grass: 2, fighting: 2, bug: 2, electric: 0.5, rock: 0.5 },
                ice: { grass: 2, ground: 2, flying: 2, dragon: 2, water: 0.5, ice: 0.5, fire: 0.5 },
                normal: { rock: 0.5, ghost: 0 },
                electric: { water: 2, flying: 2, ground: 0, grass: 0.5, electric: 0.5, dragon: 0.5 },
                grass: { water: 2, ground: 2, rock: 2, fire: 0.5, grass: 0.5, poison: 0.5, flying: 0.5, bug: 0.5,
                    dragon: 0.5 },
                poison: { grass: 2, poison: 0.5, ground: 0.5, rock: 0.5, ghost: 0.5 },
                rock: { fire: 2, ice: 2, flying: 2, bug: 2, fighting: 0.5, ground: 0.5 },
                bug: { grass: 2, psychic: 2, fire: 0.5, fighting: 0.5, poison: 0.5, flying: 0.5, ghost: 0.5 },
                psychic: { fighting: 2, poison: 2, psychic: 0.5 },
                fighting: { normal: 2, ice: 2, rock: 2, flying: 0.5, poison: 0.5, bug: 0.5, psychic: 0.5 },
                ghost: { ghost: 2, normal: 0, psychic: 0 }
            };

            function animateHpDrain(target, currentValue, newValue, maxHp, callback) {
                const startValue = currentValue;
                const diff = startValue - newValue;
                const duration = Math.min(1200, Math.max(400, Math.abs(diff) * 8));
                const startTime = performance.now();

                function step(now) {
                    const elapsed = now - startTime;
                    const progress = Math.min(1, elapsed / duration);
                    const eased = 1 - Math.pow(1 - progress, 2.5);
                    const val = startValue - diff * eased;
                    target.displayedHp = Math.max(0, val);
                    if (target === playerPokemon) {
                        updatePlayerHp();
                    } else {
                        updateEnemyHp();
                    }
                    if (progress < 1) {
                        requestAnimationFrame(step);
                    } else {
                        target.displayedHp = Math.max(0, newValue);
                        target.currentHp = Math.max(0, newValue);
                        if (target === playerPokemon) {
                            updatePlayerHp();
                        } else {
                            updateEnemyHp();
                        }
                        if (callback) callback();
                    }
                }
                requestAnimationFrame(step);
            }

            // ============ DAMAGE CALCULATION ============
            function calculateDamage(attacker, defender, move) {
                const isSpecial = move.category === 'special';
                const atkStat = isSpecial ? attacker.stats.spa : attacker.stats.atk;
                const defStat = isSpecial ? defender.stats.spd : defender.stats.def;
                const baseDamage = ((2 * attacker.level / 5 + 2) * move.power * (atkStat / defStat) / 50 + 2);
                const stab = attacker.types.includes(move.type) ? 1.5 : 1;
                const eff = getTypeEffectiveness(move.type, defender.types);
                const random = 0.85 + Math.random() * 0.15;
                const critChance = 1 / 16;
                const isCrit = Math.random() < critChance;
                const critMul = isCrit ? 2 : 1;
                const burnMul = attacker.status === 'burn' && !isSpecial ? 0.5 : 1;
                const damage = Math.max(1, Math.floor(baseDamage * stab * eff * random * critMul * burnMul));
                return { damage, eff, isCrit, stab: stab > 1 };
            }
