            // ============ TURN PROCESSING ============
            async function processPlayerMove(moveIndex) {
                const move = playerPokemon.moves[moveIndex];
                move.pp--;
                playerCanAct = false;
                sndMoveUsed();
                queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} used ${move.name}!`);
                await waitForInputOrTimeout(700);

                // Check freeze
                if (playerPokemon.status === 'freeze') {
                    if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
                        playerPokemon.status = null;
                        queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} thawed out!`);
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(500);
                    } else {
                        queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} is frozen solid!`);
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                        endPlayerTurn();
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // Check accuracy
                if (Math.random() * 100 > move.accuracy) {
                    queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name}'s attack missed!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                    endPlayerTurn();
                    return;
                }

                const result = calculateDamage(playerPokemon, enemyPokemon, move);
                enemyPokemon.currentHp = Math.max(0, enemyPokemon.currentHp - result.damage);

                // Animate attack
                playerSpriteWrap.classList.add('attack-lunge');
                setTimeout(() => playerSpriteWrap.classList.remove('attack-lunge'), 400);
                battleView.classList.add('shake');
                setTimeout(() => battleView.classList.remove('shake'), 350);
                enemySpriteWrap.classList.add('hit-flash');
                setTimeout(() => enemySpriteWrap.classList.remove('hit-flash'), 200);

                if (result.isCrit) {
                    sndCritical();
                    showDamageNumber(enemySpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(enemySpriteWrap, 'CRITICAL HIT!');
                } else if (result.eff > 1) {
                    sndSuperEffective();
                    showDamageNumber(enemySpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(enemySpriteWrap, 'SUPER EFFECTIVE!');
                } else if (result.eff < 1 && result.eff > 0) {
                    sndNotVeryEffective();
                    showDamageNumber(enemySpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(enemySpriteWrap, 'Not very effective...');
                } else if (result.eff === 0) {
                    sndNotVeryEffective();
                    queueMessage(`It doesn't affect ${enemyPokemon.name}...`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                    endPlayerTurn();
                    return;
                } else {
                    sndHit();
                    showDamageNumber(enemySpriteWrap, result.damage);
                }

                // Burn effect (Flamethrower)
                if (move.type === 'fire' && Math.random() < 0.1 && enemyPokemon.status === null) {
                    enemyPokemon.status = 'burn';
                    updateEnemyHp();
                    queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} was burned!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(500);
                }

                // Flinch effect (Air Slash)
                if (move.name === 'AIR SLASH' && Math.random() < 0.3 && enemyPokemon.currentHp > 0) {
                    // handled later
                }

                // Animate HP drain
                const oldHp = enemyPokemon.displayedHp;
                const newHp = enemyPokemon.currentHp;
                if (oldHp !== newHp) {
                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        animateHpDrain(enemyPokemon, oldHp, newHp, enemyPokemon.maxHp, resolve);
                    });
                    updateEnemyHp();
                }

                if (enemyPokemon.currentHp <= 0) {
                    enemyPokemon.displayedHp = 0;
                    updateEnemyHp();
                    sndFaint();
                    queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                    enemySpriteWrap.classList.add('faint-anim');
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                    handleVictory();
                    return;
                }

                await waitForInputOrTimeout(400);
                endPlayerTurn();
            }

            function endPlayerTurn() {
                if (battleOver) return;
                if (enemyPokemon.currentHp <= 0) return;
                battleState = 'enemyTurn';
                processEnemyTurn();
            }

            async function processEnemyTurn() {
                if (battleOver) return;
                if (enemyPokemon.currentHp <= 0) {
                    handleVictory();
                    return;
                }
                playerCanAct = false;

                // Burn damage at end of turn
                if (enemyPokemon.status === 'burn') {
                    const burnDmg = Math.max(1, Math.floor(enemyPokemon.maxHp / 16));
                    enemyPokemon.currentHp = Math.max(0, enemyPokemon.currentHp - burnDmg);
                    queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} is hurt by burn!`);
                    const oldHp = enemyPokemon.displayedHp;
                    const newHp = enemyPokemon.currentHp;
                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        animateHpDrain(enemyPokemon, oldHp, newHp, enemyPokemon.maxHp, resolve);
                    });
                    if (enemyPokemon.currentHp <= 0) {
                        enemyPokemon.displayedHp = 0;
                        updateEnemyHp();
                        sndFaint();
                        queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                        enemySpriteWrap.classList.add('faint-anim');
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                        handleVictory();
                        return;
                    }
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(400);
                }

                // Remove burn end of turn
                if (enemyPokemon.status === 'burn') {
                    enemyPokemon.status = null;
                    updateEnemyHp();
                }

                // Check freeze
                if (enemyPokemon.status === 'freeze') {
                    if (Math.random() < 0.2) {
                        enemyPokemon.status = null;
                        queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} thawed out!`);
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(500);
                        updateEnemyHp();
                    } else {
                        queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} is frozen solid!`);
                        await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                        endEnemyTurn();
                        return;
                    }
                }

                // Choose move (smart-ish)
                const allMoves = enemyPokemon.moves.filter(m => m.pp > 0);
                if (allMoves.length === 0) {
                    queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} has no moves left!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                    endEnemyTurn();
                    return;
                }
                const move = allMoves[Math.floor(Math.random() * allMoves.length)];

                sndMoveUsed();
                queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} used ${move.name}!`);
                await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);

                if (Math.random() * 100 > move.accuracy) {
                    queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name}'s attack missed!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                    endEnemyTurn();
                    return;
                }

                const result = calculateDamage(enemyPokemon, playerPokemon, move);
                playerPokemon.currentHp = Math.max(0, playerPokemon.currentHp - result.damage);

                enemySpriteWrap.classList.add('attack-lunge');
                setTimeout(() => enemySpriteWrap.classList.remove('attack-lunge'), 400);
                battleView.classList.add('shake');
                setTimeout(() => battleView.classList.remove('shake'), 350);
                playerSpriteWrap.classList.add('hit-flash');
                setTimeout(() => playerSpriteWrap.classList.remove('hit-flash'), 200);

                if (result.isCrit) {
                    sndCritical();
                    showDamageNumber(playerSpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(playerSpriteWrap, 'CRITICAL HIT!');
                } else if (result.eff > 1) {
                    sndSuperEffective();
                    showDamageNumber(playerSpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(playerSpriteWrap, 'SUPER EFFECTIVE!');
                } else if (result.eff < 1 && result.eff > 0) {
                    sndNotVeryEffective();
                    showDamageNumber(playerSpriteWrap, result.damage);
                    showEffectText(playerSpriteWrap, 'Not very effective...');
                } else if (result.eff === 0) {
                    sndNotVeryEffective();
                    queueMessage(`It doesn't affect ${playerPokemon.name}...`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(600);
                    endEnemyTurn();
                    return;
                } else {
                    sndHit();
                    showDamageNumber(playerSpriteWrap, result.damage);
                }

                // Burn effect (Ice Beam freeze chance)
                if (move.type === 'ice' && Math.random() < 0.1 && playerPokemon.status === null) {
                    playerPokemon.status = 'freeze';
                    updatePlayerHp();
                    queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} was frozen solid!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(500);
                }

                // Animate HP drain
                const oldHp = playerPokemon.displayedHp;
                const newHp = playerPokemon.currentHp;
                if (oldHp !== newHp) {
                    await new Promise(resolve => {
                        animateHpDrain(playerPokemon, oldHp, newHp, playerPokemon.maxHp, resolve);
                    });
                    updatePlayerHp();
                }

                if (playerPokemon.currentHp <= 0) {
                    playerPokemon.displayedHp = 0;
                    updatePlayerHp();
                    sndFaint();
                    queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                    playerSpriteWrap.classList.add('faint-anim');
                    await waitForInputOrTimeout(800);
                    handleDefeat();
                    return;
                }

                await waitForInputOrTimeout(400);
                endEnemyTurn();
            }

            function endEnemyTurn() {
                if (battleOver) return;
                if (playerPokemon.currentHp <= 0) return;
                // Player burn damage
                if (playerPokemon.status === 'burn') {
                    const burnDmg = Math.max(1, Math.floor(playerPokemon.maxHp / 16));
                    playerPokemon.currentHp = Math.max(0, playerPokemon.currentHp - burnDmg);
                    queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} is hurt by burn!`);
                    const oldHp = playerPokemon.displayedHp;
                    const newHp = playerPokemon.currentHp;
                    animateHpDrain(playerPokemon, oldHp, newHp, playerPokemon.maxHp, () => {});
                    if (playerPokemon.currentHp <= 0) {
                        playerPokemon.displayedHp = 0;
                        updatePlayerHp();
                        sndFaint();
                        queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                        setTimeout(() => {
                            playerSpriteWrap.classList.add('faint-anim');
                            handleDefeat();
                        }, 800);
                        return;
                    }
                }
                playerPokemon.status = null;
                updatePlayerHp();
                turnCount++;
                if (!battleOver) {
                    queueMessage(`What will ${playerPokemon.name} do?`);
                    playerCanAct = true;
                    battleState = 'playerTurn';
                    setTimeout(() => showMenu('action'), 600);
                }
            }

            function handleVictory() {
                battleOver = true;
                battleState = 'victory';
                hideMenu();
                sndVictory();
                queueMessage(`${enemyPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showWinnerBanner('VICTORY!', 'You defeated BLASTOISE!');
                    queueMessage(`You won the battle!`);
                    sndExpGain();
                    expBarFill.style.width = '100%';
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} gained experience!`);
                    }, 1000);
                }, 800);
            }

            function handleDefeat() {
                battleOver = true;
                battleState = 'defeat';
                hideMenu();
                sndDefeat();
                queueMessage(`${playerPokemon.name} fainted!`);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    showWinnerBanner('DEFEAT...', 'You lose. Try again!');
                    queueMessage(`You lost the battle...`);
                }, 800);
            }

            function showWinnerBanner(text, sub) {
                winnerText.textContent = text;
                winnerSub.textContent = sub;
                winnerBanner.style.display = 'block';
            }

            function showDamageNumber(wrapEl, amount) {
                const el = document.createElement('div');
                el.className = 'damage-number';
                el.textContent = `-${amount}`;
                const rect = wrapEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                const containerRect = battleView.getBoundingClientRect();
                el.style.left = (rect.left - containerRect.left + rect.width * 0.5) + 'px';
                el.style.top = (rect.top - containerRect.top + rect.height * 0.3) + 'px';
                battleView.appendChild(el);
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 950);
            }

            function showEffectText(wrapEl, text) {
                const el = document.createElement('div');
                el.className = 'effect-text';
                el.textContent = text;
                const rect = wrapEl.getBoundingClientRect();
                const containerRect = battleView.getBoundingClientRect();
                el.style.left = (rect.left - containerRect.left + rect.width * 0.2) + 'px';
                el.style.top = (rect.top - containerRect.top - 20) + 'px';
                battleView.appendChild(el);
                setTimeout(() => el.remove(), 1250);
            }

            function waitForInputOrTimeout(timeout) {
                return new Promise(resolve => {
                    const startTime = Date.now();
                    const checkInterval = setInterval(() => {
                        if (Date.now() - startTime >= timeout) {
                            clearInterval(checkInterval);
                            resolve();
                        }
                    }, 50);
                    // Also resolve if user clicks dialogue to advance
                    const clickHandler = () => {
                        clearInterval(checkInterval);
                        dialogueBox.removeEventListener('click', clickHandler);
                        resolve();
                    };
                    dialogueBox.addEventListener('click', clickHandler);
                    // But don't immediately resolve on click during typing
                    if (isTyping) {
                        dialogueBox.removeEventListener('click', clickHandler);
                    }
                });
            }

            // ============ RESET GAME ============
            function resetGame() {
                battleOver = false;
                battleState = 'idle';
                turnCount = 0;
                playerPokemon.currentHp = playerPokemon.maxHp;
                playerPokemon.displayedHp = playerPokemon.maxHp;
                playerPokemon.status = null;
                playerPokemon.moves.forEach(m => m.pp = m.maxPp);
                enemyPokemon.currentHp = enemyPokemon.maxHp;
                enemyPokemon.displayedHp = enemyPokemon.maxHp;
                enemyPokemon.status = null;
                enemyPokemon.moves.forEach(m => m.pp = m.maxPp);
                expBarFill.style.width = '40%';
                winnerBanner.style.display = 'none';
                enemySpriteWrap.classList.remove('faint-anim');
                playerSpriteWrap.classList.remove('faint-anim');
                hideMenu();
                clearMessages();
                updateAllHpBars();
                updateMovePpDisplay();
            }

            function startBattle() {
                ensureAudio();
                resetGame();
                titleOverlay.classList.add('hidden');
                queueMessage(`A wild ${enemyPokemon.name} appeared!`);
                setTimeout(() => {
                    queueMessage(`Go! ${playerPokemon.name}!`);
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        battleState = 'playerTurn';
                        playerCanAct = true;
                        queueMessage(`What will ${playerPokemon.name} do?`);
                        setTimeout(() => showMenu('action'), 600);
                    }, 800);
                }, 900);
            }

            // ============ EVENT LISTENERS ============
            dialogueBox.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (isTyping) {
                    skipTyping();
                } else if (isWaitingForInput) {
                    showNextMessage();
                }
            });

            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'ArrowUp' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (currentMenu) {
                        const delta = e.key === 'ArrowDown' ? (currentMenu === 'action' ? 2 : 2) : (currentMenu ===
                            'action' ? -2 : -2);
                        navigateMenu(delta);
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (currentMenu) navigateMenu(-1);
                } else if (e.key === 'ArrowRight') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (currentMenu) navigateMenu(1);
                } else if (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ') {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    if (currentMenu) {
                        selectMenuAction();
                    } else if (isTyping || isWaitingForInput) {
                        skipTyping();
                    }
                } else if (e.key === 'Escape' && currentMenu === 'move') {
                    showMenu('action');
                    sndMenuMove();
                } else if (e.key === 'z' || e.key === 'Z') {
                    if (currentMenu) selectMenuAction();
                } else if (e.key === 'x' || e.key === 'X') {
                    if (currentMenu === 'move') {
                        showMenu('action');
                        sndMenuMove();
                    }
                }
            });

            actionGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item').forEach((item) => {
                item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const idx = Array.from(actionGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).indexOf(item);
                    selectedMenuIndex = idx;
                    highlightMenuItems();
                    selectMenuAction();
                });
                item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    selectedMenuIndex = Array.from(actionGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).indexOf(item);
                    highlightMenuItems();
                });
            });

            moveGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item').forEach((item) => {
                item.addEventListener('click', () => {
                    const idx = Array.from(moveGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).indexOf(item);
                    selectedMenuIndex = idx;
                    highlightMenuItems();
                    selectMenuAction();
                });
                item.addEventListener('mouseenter', () => {
                    selectedMenuIndex = Array.from(moveGrid.querySelectorAll('.menu-item')).indexOf(item);
                    highlightMenuItems();
                });
            });

            startBtn.addEventListener('click', startBattle);
            titleOverlay.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                if (e.target === titleOverlay || e.target === startBtn) {
                    startBattle();
                }
            });

            partyBall1.addEventListener('click', () => {
                if (!battleOver) {
                    queueMessage('CHARIZARD is already in battle!');
                }
            });

            // Draw sprites on load
            drawSprites();

            // Initialize UI
            updateAllHpBars();

            // Ensure game container fits
            function resizeGame() {
                const container = gameContainer;
                const maxW = window.innerWidth - 20;
                const maxH = window.innerHeight - 20;
                const aspectRatio = 5 / 3.6;
                let w = Math.min(maxW, 860);
                let h = w / aspectRatio;
                if (h > maxH) {
                    h = maxH;
                    w = h * aspectRatio;
                }
                container.style.width = Math.min(w, 860) + 'px';
                container.style.height = h + 'px';
            }
            resizeGame();
            window.addEventListener('resize', resizeGame);

            // Keyboard shortcut for title
            document.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => {
                if (e.key === 'Enter' && !titleOverlay.classList.contains('hidden') && battleState === 'idle') {
                    startBattle();
                }
            });
        })();
    </script>
</body>
</html>

prompt: Recreate a Pokémon battle UI — make it interactive, nostalgic, and fun. Stick to the spirit of a classic battle, but feel free to get creative if you want. In a single-page self-contained HTML.
content:
<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1">
<title>POCKET BATTLE · Wild Chain</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Press+Start+2P&family=Space+Grotesk:wght@400;500;700&family=VT323&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
/* ============ TOKENS ============ */
:root{
  --ink:#151024; --ink2:#2a2140;
  --cream:#f6eedb; --cream2:#e3d6b8; --paper:#fffaf0;
  --night:#0d1020; --night2:#161b31; --edge:#2c3558;
  --red:#e04b3f; --blue:#3a8fd8; --gold:#ffc94a; --teal:#39c4b4;
  --hpok:#4fd06b; --hphalf:#ffd23f; --hpcrit:#ff5b4a;
  --fire:#f2762e; --water:#3a97e8; --grass:#4cc46a; --elec:#f2c81e;
  --rock:#b09264; --normal:#a3a9b8; --flying:#8fbfe8; --psy:#f0578f;
  --bug:#8fc03a; --ground:#d09a4e; --poison:#a955c9;
  --shadow:5px 5px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.5);
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0}
body{
  background:var(--night);
  color:#e9e6f5;
  font-family:'Space Grotesk',system-ui,-apple-system,sans-serif;
  min-height:100vh; overflow-x:hidden;
}
body::before{
  content:''; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0;
  background:
    radial-gradient(900px 520px at 50% 34%, rgba(80,150,255,.20), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(600px 400px at 12% 88%, rgba(224,75,63,.13), transparent 70%),
    radial-gradient(600px 400px at 92% 8%, rgba(255,201,74,.10), transparent 70%);
}
body::after{
  content:''; position:fixed; inset:0; pointer-events:none; z-index:0; opacity:.5;
  background-image:linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px),
                   linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.035) 1px,transparent 1px);
  background-size:34px 34px;
  mask-image:radial-gradient(1000px 700px at 50% 30%,#000,transparent 85%);
}
.defs{position:absolute;width:0;height:0;overflow:hidden}

/* ============ CHROME ============ */
.deck{position:relative;z-index:1;max-width:1290px;margin:0 auto;padding:16px clamp(10px,2.4vw,24px) 44px}
.hud{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;
  padding-bottom:12px;border-bottom:3px solid var(--edge);margin-bottom:16px}
.hud-id{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.hud-id .dot{width:10px;height:10px;background:var(--red);box-shadow:0 0 12px var(--red);animation:pulse 1.6s infinite}
@keyframes pulse{0%,100%{opacity:1}50%{opacity:.25}}
h1{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:clamp(15px,2.3vw,23px);margin:0;letter-spacing:-1px;
  color:var(--cream);text-shadow:3px 3px 0 #000, 0 0 26px rgba(255,201,74,.35)}
h1 em{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.sub{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.24em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#8f9ac4;margin:2px 0 0}
.hud-stats{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.stat{background:var(--night2);border:2px solid var(--edge);padding:6px 11px;min-width:74px}
.stat b{display:block;font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:14px;color:var(--gold);line-height:1}
.stat span{font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.18em;color:#8790b8;text-transform:uppercase}
.stat.flash b{animation:statpop .5s}
@keyframes statpop{0%{transform:scale(1)}40%{transform:scale(1.5);color:#fff}100%{transform:scale(1)}}
.hud-btns{display:flex;gap:7px}
.btn{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:8px;color:var(--cream);background:#232a4a;
  border:2px solid var(--edge);padding:9px 10px;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:0;transition:.12s}
.btn:hover{background:var(--gold);color:var(--ink);transform:translate(-2px,-2px);box-shadow:3px 3px 0 #000}
.btn.off{opacity:.45}
.btn.on{background:#3b5bd8;color:#fff}

.arena{display:grid;grid-template-columns:216px minmax(0,1fr) 254px;gap:14px;align-items:start}
@media(max-width:1120px){.arena{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 254px}.rail-l{grid-column:1/-1;order:3}}
@media(max-width:820px){.arena{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)}.rail{order:3}}

/* ============ RAILS ============ */
.rail{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.card{background:linear-gradient(#1b2138,#12172a);border:3px solid #000;box-shadow:var(--shadow),inset 0 0 0 2px #2f3a63}
.card-h{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;
  font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:8px;padding:9px 10px;background:#0a0e1c;border-bottom:2px solid var(--edge);color:#a9b4e0}
.card-h i{font-style:normal;color:var(--gold)}
.card-b{padding:10px}

.pt{display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:center;padding:7px;border:2px solid transparent;background:#0f1526;
  margin-bottom:7px;transition:.14s;position:relative;cursor:default}
.pt:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.pt svg{width:34px;height:34px;flex:0 0 34px}
.pt .nm{font-family:'Press Start 2P',monospace;font-size:8px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.pt .lv{font-size:10px;color:#8b93bb}
.pt.sel{border-color:var(--gold);background:#1d2440;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px #000}
.pt.sel::before{content:'▶';position:absolute;left:-11px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);color:var(--gold);font-size:11px}
.pt.ko{filter:grayscale(1) brightness(.6)}
.pt.pickable{cursor:pointer}
.pt.pickable:hover{border-color:var(--teal);transform:translateX(3px)}
.mini{height:7px;background:#3a1220;border:2px solid #000;margin-top:4px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.mini i{position:absolute;inset:0;transform-origin:left;transition:transform .35s}
.chips{display:flex;gap:3px;margin-top:4px}
.chip{font-family:'Press Start 2P',font-size:6px;padding:2px 4px;border:1px solid #000;color:#0d0d16}

.dexno{font-family:'Press Start 2P',font-size:26px;color:#2b3a6b;line-height:1}
.dexname{font-family:'Press Start 2P',font-size:11px;color:var(--cream);margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:-.5px}
.dexrow{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-top:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.tb{font-family:'Press Start 2P',font-size:6.5px;padding:4px 6px;border:2px solid #000;color:#fff;
  text-shadow:1px 1px 0 rgba(0,0,0,.55);letter-spacing:.04em}
.tb.fire{background:var(--fire)}.tb.water{background:var(--water)}.tb.grass{background:var(--grass)}
.tb.elec{background:var(--elec);color:#3a2c00;text-shadow:none}.tb.rock{background:var(--rock)}
.tb.normal{background:var(--normal)}.tb.flying{background:var(--flying);color:#123;text-shadow:none}
.tb.psy{background:var(--psy)}.tb.bug{background:var(--bug)}.tb.ground{background:var(--ground)}
.tb.poison{background:var(--poison)}
.pbar{display:grid;grid-template-columns:38px 1fr 26px;gap:6px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:5px;font-size:10px;color:#9aa3cc}
.pbar .t{height:8px;background:#0a0e1c;border:2px solid #000;overflow:hidden}
.pbar .t i{display:block;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,var(--teal),var(--gold));transition:width .5s}
.pbar b{font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:16px;color:var(--cream);text-align:right}
.flavor{font-size:11.5px;line-height:1.5;color:#b6bee2;border-left:3px solid var(--edge);padding-left:9px;margin:10px 0 0}
.readout{font-family:'VT323',monospace;font-size:22px;color:var(--cream);line-height:1}
.readout .mult{font-family:'Press Start 2P';font-size:14px}
.readout small{font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:10.5px;color:#8b93bb;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase}
#log{max-height:230px;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;scrollbar-width:thin}
#log div{font-size:11px;line-height:1.35;color:#a8b1d8;border-left:3px solid var(--edge);padding-left:7px;animation:slidein .3s}
#log div.hit{color:#ffd0a8;border-color:var(--red)}
#log div.good{color:#b6f0c2;border-color:var(--grass)}
#log div.sys{color:#8fa9ff;border-color:var(--blue)}
@keyframes slidein{from{opacity:0;transform:translateX(-6px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}

/* ============ SCREEN ============ */
.screen-shell{position:relative}
.screen{position:relative;background:#05070f;border:4px solid #000;padding:9px;
  box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #3a4370, 0 26px 50px -18px #000, 0 0 90px -20px rgba(90,160,255,.4)}
.screen.shake{animation:shake .38s cubic-bezier(.36,.07,.19,.97)}
@keyframes shake{10%,90%{transform:translate(-2px,1px)}20%,80%{transform:translate(4px,-2px)}
30%,50%,70%{transform:translate(-6px,3px)}40%,60%{transform:translate(6px,-3px)}100%{transform:none}}
.bezel-note{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-top:9px;
  font-size:9.5px;letter-spacing:.22em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#68729e}
.bezel-note span{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.led{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--grass);box-shadow:0 0 10px var(--grass)}

/* stage */
.stage{position:relative;height:clamp(280px,38vh,372px);overflow:hidden;background:#8fd6f2;border:3px solid #000}
.sky{position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(#4fb2e8 0%,#8fd6f2 42%,#cdefff 72%,#e9f8d8 100%)}
.sun{position:absolute;left:9%;top:8%;width:110px;height:110px;background:radial-gradient(circle,#fff 12%,rgba(255,246,190,.75) 34%,transparent 68%);animation:sundrift 24s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sundrift{0%,100%{transform:translate(0,0)}50%{transform:translate(26px,10px)}}
.clouds i{position:absolute;height:26px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.85);border-radius:2px;
  box-shadow:26px 6px 0 -4px rgba(255,255,255,.85),52px 2px 0 -8px rgba(255,255,255,.8)}
.clouds i:nth-child(1){width:70px;top:16%;left:-10%;animation:drift 46s linear infinite}
.clouds i:nth-child(2){width:52px;top:31%;left:-20%;animation:drift 66s linear infinite 8s;opacity:.7}
.clouds i:nth-child(3){width:88px;top:8%;left:-30%;animation:drift 88s linear infinite 20s;opacity:.5}
@keyframes drift{to{transform:translateX(160vw)}}
.hills{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100%;height:66%}
.grassband{position:absolute;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;height:26%;
  background:repeating-linear-gradient(90deg,#6ec25c 0 8px,#63b854 8px 16px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 4px 0 #7fd06a, inset 0 -10px 0 #4c9a44}
.grassband::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.35;
  background-image:radial-gradient(#2f6d2c 1px,transparent 1.4px);background-size:8px 8px}
.tuft{position:absolute;bottom:0;width:14px;height:16px;background:#3f8a3a;
  clip-path:polygon(0 100%,20% 30%,35% 100%,55% 10%,70% 100%,88% 40%,100% 100%);transform-origin:bottom center;animation:sway 3.4s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes sway{0%,100%{transform:skewX(-4deg)}50%{transform:skewX(6deg)}}
.ledge{position:absolute;width:0;height:0}
.ledge.e{right:11%;bottom:24%}
.ledge.p{left:12%;bottom:6%}
.ledge .dish{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%);border-radius:50%;
  background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 30%,#8ede76,#5aa64d 70%);
  box-shadow:0 6px 0 #3d7a38, inset 0 3px 0 #a8ef8e}
.ledge.e .dish{width:180px;height:44px}
.ledge.p .dish{width:250px;height:58px}
.ledge .dish::after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;border-radius:50%;opacity:.4;
  background-image:radial-gradient(#2f6d2c 1px,transparent 1.3px);background-size:6px 6px}
.slot{position:absolute;left:50%;transform:translateX(-50%)}
.ledge.e .slot{bottom:22px}
.ledge.p .slot{bottom:30px}
.mon{position:relative;animation:bob 2.6s ease-in-out infinite;transform-origin:bottom center;
  filter:drop-shadow(0 8px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.25))}
.mon svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;shape-rendering:crispEdges}
.mon.p svg{transform:scaleX(-1)}
.mon.e{width:clamp(96px,12vw,132px)}
.mon.p{width:clamp(128px,16vw,178px)}
@keyframes bob{0%,100%{transform:translateY(0) scaleY(1)}50%{transform:translateY(-5px) scaleY(1.015)}}
.mon.hurt{animation:hurt .5s}
@keyframes hurt{0%,100%{filter:none}0%{filter:brightness(6) saturate(0)}25%{filter:brightness(.4)}
50%{filter:brightness(6) saturate(0)}75%{transform:translateX(8px)}}
.mon.lunge-p{animation:lungeP .45s ease-in-out}

<script>
/* ===================================================================
   0 · UTILS
=================================================================== */
const $=s=>document.querySelector(s), $$=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)];
const rnd=n=>Math.floor(Math.random()*n);
const pick=a=>a[rnd(a.length)];
const chance=p=>Math.random()<p;
const clamp=(v,a,b)=>Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const sleep=ms=>new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,ms));
const cap=s=>s[0].toUpperCase()+s.slice(1);
function hex2hsl(h){h=h.replace('#','');const r=parseInt(h.slice(0,2),16)/255,g=parseInt(h.slice(2,4),16)/255,b=parseInt(h.slice(4,6),16)/255;
 const mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b);let hh=0,s=0,l=(mx+mn)/2;const d=mx-mn;
 if(d){s=l>.5?d/(2-mx-mn):d/(mx+mn);switch(mx){case r:hh=((g-b)/d+(g<b?6:0));break;case g:hh=(b-r)/d+2;break;default:hh=(r-g)/d+4}hh*=60}
 return[h,s,l]}
function hsl2hex(h,s,l){const f=n=>{const k=(n+h/30)%12;const c=l-s*Math.min(l,1-l)*Math.max(-1,Math.min(k-3,9-k,1));
 return Math.round(255*Math.max(0,Math.min(1,c))).toString(16).padStart(2,'0')};return '#'+f(0)+f(8)+f(4)}
const adjust=(c,o)=>{const[h,s,l]=hex2hsl(c);return hsl2hex((h+(o.h||0)+360)%360,clamp(s+(o.s||0),0,1),clamp(l+(o.l||0),0,1))};

/* ===================================================================
   1 · AUDIO (synth chiptune + sfx)
=================================================================== */
const A=(()=>{
  let ctx=null,master=null,mus=null,sfxG=null,on=true,noteTimer=null,step=0;
  const NOTE={C:0,D:2,E:4,F:5,G:7,A:9,B:11};
  function f(n){const m=/^([A-G][b#]?)(\d)$/.exec(n);if(!m)return 0;let s=NOTE[m[1][0]]+(m[1][1]==='#'?1:m[1][1]==='b'?-1:0);
    return 440*Math.pow(2,((s+(+m[2]-9)*12)-9)/12)}
  function init(){if(ctx)return;const AC=window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext;ctx=new AC();
    master=ctx.createGain();master.gain.value=.6;master.connect(ctx.destination);
    mus=ctx.createGain();mus.gain.value=.14;mus.connect(master);
    sfxG=ctx.createGain();sfxG.gain.value=.34;sfxG.connect(master);
    let buf=ctx.createBuffer(1,ctx.sampleRate*.4,ctx.sampleRate);let d=buf.getChannelData(0);
    for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++)d[i]=Math.random()*2-1;A.noiseBuf=buf;}
  function blip(freq,dur,type,vol,dest,slide){
    if(!ctx||!on)return;const t=ctx.currentTime;const o=ctx.createOscillator(),g=ctx.createGain();
    o.type=type||'square';o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t);
    if(slide)o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(Math.max(30,freq+slide),t+dur);
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(0,t);g.gain.linearRampToValueAtTime(vol||.2,t+.008);
    g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);
    o.connect(g);g.connect(dest||sfxG);o.start(t);o.stop(t+dur+.02);}
  function noise(dur,vol,hp){if(!ctx||!on)return;const t=ctx.currentTime;const s=ctx.createBufferSource();
    s.buffer=A.noiseBuf;const g=ctx.createGain();const bq=ctx.createBiquadFilter();bq.type='highpass';bq.frequency.value=hp||3000;
    g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol||.15,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.0001,t+dur);
    s.connect(bq);bq.connect(g);g.connect(sfxG);s.start(t);s.stop(t+dur);}
  const LEAD=[['E5',null,'A5',null,'G5',null,'E5',null,'C5',null,'D5',null,'E5',null,null,null],
              ['F5',null,'A5',null,'F5',null,'C5',null,'D5',null,'F5',null,'A5',null,null,null],
              ['G5',null,'E5',null,'C5',null,'D5',null,'E5',null,'G5',null,'E5',null,null,null],
              ['D5',null,'G5',null,'B5',null,'A5',null,'G5',null,'E5',null,'D5',null,null,null]];
  const BASS=[['A2','A2','A3','A2','A2','A2','A3','A2'],['F2','F2','F3','F2','F2','F2','F3','F2'],
              ['C3','C3','C3','C3','C3','C3','G3','G3'],['G2','G2','G3','G2','G2','G2','B2','D3']];
  function tickMusic(){
    if(!ctx||!on)return;
    const bar=Math.floor(step/16)%4, i=step%16;
    const ln=LEAD[bar][i]; if(ln) blip(f(ln),.13,'square',.09,mus);
    if(i%2===0){const bn=BASS[bar][i/2];if(bn)blip(f(bn),.18,'triangle',.16,mus)}
    if(i%4===2) noise(.05,.05,6000);
    step++;
  }
  return{
    init(){init();if(ctx&&ctx.state==='suspended')ctx.resume()},
    get on(){return on},
    toggle(){on=!on;if(!on&&noteTimer){clearInterval(noteTimer);noteTimer=null}else if(on&&ctx&&!noteTimer)noteTimer=setInterval(tickMusic,112);return on},
    music(){init();if(!noteTimer&&on)noteTimer=setInterval(tickMusic,112)},
    sfx:{
      blip:()=>blip(1180,.02,'square',.05),
      cursor:()=>blip(760,.04,'square',.12),
      ok:()=>{blip(660,.05,'square',.16);setTimeout(()=>blip(990,.07,'square',.16),50)},
      back:()=>blip(420,.07,'square',.13),
      hit:()=>{noise(.12,.25,900);blip(180,.1,'square',.2,0,-120)},
      super:()=>{noise(.2,.32,600);blip(300,.18,'sawtooth',.2,0,-220);setTimeout(()=>blip(900,.12,'square',.15),60)},
      weak:()=>{noise(.08,.12,1400);blip(300,.08,'triangle',.12)},
      miss:()=>blip(1500,.09,'sine',.1,0,-1100),
      heal:()=>{[523,659,784,1046].forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>blip(n,.1,'triangle',.14),i*60))},
      faint:()=>{[440,392,330,262,196].forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>blip(n,.14,'square',.16),i*80))},
      level:()=>{[523,659,784,1046,1318].forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>blip(n,.12,'square',.18),i*70))},
      catch:()=>{[784,988,1175,1568].forEach((n,i)=>setTimeout(()=>blip(n,.16,'square',.2),i*110))},

const GW=20,GH=20;
function newGrid(){return Array.from({length:GH},()=>Array(GW).fill(null))}
function set(g,x,y,c){x=Math.round(x);y=Math.round(y);if(x>=0&&x<GW&&y>=0&&y<GH)g[y][x]=c}
function disc(g,cx,cy,rx,ry,c){for(let y=Math.floor(cy-ry);y<=Math.ceil(cy+ry);y++)for(let x=Math.floor(cx-rx);x<=Math.ceil(cx+rx);x++){
  const dx=(x+.0-cx)/rx,dy=(y-cy)/ry;if(dx*dx+dy*dy<=1)set(g,x,y,c)}}
function sgn(px,py,ax,ay,bx,by){return(px-bx)*(ay-by)-(ax-px)*(by-py)}
function tri(g,a,b,c2,col){const xs=[a[0],b[0],c2[0]],ys=[a[1],b[1],c2[1]];
  for(let y=Math.floor(Math.min(...ys));y<=Math.ceil(Math.max(...ys));y++)
   for(let x=Math.floor(Math.min(...xs));x<=Math.ceil(Math.max(...xs));x++){
    const s1=sgn(x,y,...a,...b),s2=sgn(x,y,...b,...c2),s3=sgn(x,y,...c2,...a);
    const neg=s1<0||s2<0||s3<0,pos=s1>0||s2>0||s3>0;if(!(neg&&pos))set(g,x,y,col)}}
function line(g,x1,y1,x2,y2,c){const n=Math.max(Math.abs(x2-x1),Math.abs(y2-y1));for(let i=0;i<=n;i++)set(g,x1+(x2-x1)*i/n,y1+(y2-y1)*i/n,c)}
function ring(g,cx,cy,rx,ry,c){for(let a=0;a<6.283;a+=.06){set(g,cx+Math.cos(a)*rx,cy+Math.sin(a)*ry,c)}}
function dots(g,pts,c){pts.forEach(p=>set(g,p[0],p[1],c))}
function shade(g,cols){
  const src=cols.map(c=>c);
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    const v=g[y][x];if(!v||!src.includes(v))continue;
    const up=(y>0?g[y-1][x]:null),lf=(x>0?g[y][x-1]:null),dn=(y<GH-1?g[y+1][x]:null),rt=(x<GW-1?g[y][x+1]:null);
    if(!up||!lf)g[y][x]=adjust(v,{l:.16,s:-.04});
    else if(!dn||!rt)g[y][x]=adjust(v,{l:-.15,s:.05});
  }
}
function outline(g,c){
  const add=[];
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++)for(let x=0;x<GW;x++){
    if(g[y][x])continue;
    let touch=false;
    for(let dy=-1;dy<=1;dy++)for(let dx=-1;dx<=1;dx++){
      if(!dx&&!dy)continue;const nx=x+dx,ny=y+dy;
      if(nx>=0&&nx<GW&&ny>=0&&ny<GH&&g[ny][nx])touch=true;
    }
    if(touch)add.push([x,y]);
  }
  add.forEach(p=>g[p[1]][p[0]]=c);
}
function gridToSymbol(g,id){
  let out='';
  for(let y=0;y<GH;y++){let x=0;while(x<GW){const c=g[y][x];if(!c){x++;continue}
    let w=1;while(x+w<GW&&g[y][x+w]===c)w++;
    out+=`<rect x="${x}" y="${y}" width="${w}" height="1" fill="${c}"/>`;x+=w}}
  return `<symbol id="${id}" viewBox="0 0 ${GW} ${GH}">${out}</symbol>`;
}

function askKey(e){
  if(confirmer&&(e==='z'||e==='enter')){const f=confirmer;confirmer=null;f();return true}
  if(!menu)return false;
  const items=menu.items;
  if(e==='back'){if(menu.kind!=='main'){A.sfx.back();closeMenu('back')}return true}
  let n=items.length;
  const cols=menu.kind==='main'?2:1;
  if(e==='up')menu.cur=(menu.cur-cols+n)%n;
  else if(e==='down')menu.cur=(menu.cur+cols)%n;
  else if(e==='left'&&cols===2)menu.cur=(menu.cur+1)%2+Math.floor(menu.cur/2)*2;
  else if(e==='right'&&cols===2)menu.cur=(menu.cur+1)%n;
  else if(e==='enter'){const it=items[menu.cur];if(it.dis){A.sfx.back();return true}A.sfx.ok();closeMenu(menu.cur);return true}
  else if(/^[1-9]$/.test(e)){const i=+e-1;if(i<n&&!items[i].dis){A.sfx.ok();closeMenu(i)}else A.sfx.back();return true}
  A.sfx.cursor();renderMenu();return true;
}

function burst(x,y,type,dir=1){

    leaf:['#4cc46a','#8fc03a','#dff3c9'],spark:['#ffe27a','#ffffff','#f2c81e'],

    dust:['#d09a4e','#b1946a','#e8d3a8'],heal:['#9dffc0','#4fd06b','#ffffff'],
    stars:['#ffe27a','#ffffff','#f0578f'],impact:['#ffffff','#ffe27a','#c9d2ff'],
    shield:['#b1946a','#dff3ff','#ffffff'],cry:['#ffffff','#8fbfe8','#bfe9ff']}[type]||['#fff'];
  const n=type==='heal'?10:14;

      dx:Math.cos(a)*r*dir*.6+dir*22,dy:Math.sin(a)*r-(type==='ember'||type==='bubble'?40:0),

async function tweenHP(side,to){
  const u=side==='e'?foe():me();if(!u)return;
  const from=u._shown??u.hp;u.hp=Math.max(0,to);
  const step=Math.sign(to-from);
  if(step===0){u._shown=to;paintHP(side);return}
  const chunk=Math.max(1,Math.round(Math.abs(to-from)/9));
  let cur=from;
  while((step<0&&cur>to)||(step>0&&cur<to)){
    cur=step<0?Math.max(to,cur-chunk):Math.min(to,cur+chunk);
    u._shown=cur;paintHP(side);A.sfx.hit&&A.sfx.weak();
    await sleep(58);
  }
  u._shown=to;paintHP(side);
  if(to<=0)A.sfx.faint();
  else if(to/maxhpLess(u)) {}
}
const maxhpLess=u=>u.maxhp;
async function tweenXP(u,frac){
  const from=u._expShown??0;const dir=Math.sign(frac-from);const chunk=Math.max(.02,Math.abs(frac-from)/12);
  let cur=from;
  while((dir>0&&cur<frac)||(dir<0&&cur>frac)){cur=clamp(cur+dir*chunk,0,1);u._expShown=cur;paintHP('p');A.sfx.blip();await sleep(40)}
  u._expShown=frac;paintHP('p');
}

function spdOf(u){let v=u.spd*statStage(u.stages.spd);if(u.status==='PAR')v*=.5;return v}
function hitRoll(mv,user,target){
  if(!mv.acc||mv.acc>=100&&user.status!=='PAR')return true;
  return Math.random()*100 < mv.acc*acc(user)/acc(target);
}
function calcDamage(user,target,slot){
  const mv=MOVES[slot.id];
  const e=effOf(mv.type,target.sp.types);
  if(!mv.power||e===0)return{dmg:0,eff:e,crit:false};
  const A_=Math.max(1,user.atk*statStage(user.stages.atk));
  const D_=Math.max(1,target.def*statStage(target.stages.def));
  let base=Math.floor(Math.floor(Math.floor(Math.floor(2*user.lv/10+2)*mv.power*A_)/D_)/50)+2;
  const critChance=(1/16)*(mv.crit||1)*(user.spd>100?1.3:1);
  const crit=chance(critChance);
  let r=Math.floor(Math.random()*41)+215;
  let dmg=base*r/255*(crit?2:1)*(mv.type===user.sp.types[0]||mv.type===user.sp.types[1]?1.5:1)*e;
  if(user.status==='SCORCH'&&mv.cat==='phys')dmg*=.75;
  return{dmg:Math.max(1,Math.floor(dmg)),eff:e,crit};
}
async function applyDamage(side,target,amount){
  const t=centerOf(side);
  const before=target.hp;
  await tweenHP(side,Math.max(0,before-amount));
  dmgPop(t.x,t.y-t.w*.2,'−'+amount);
}

  if(statTarget){

    await say(`${nm(target)}’s ${mv.stat.t.toUpperCase()} fell!`,{hold:500});
  }
}
const dirOf=s=>s==='e'?1:-1;
function aiChoose(){
  const f=foe(),p=me();const usable=f.moves.filter(s=>s.pp>0);
  if(!usable.length)return null;
  let best=null,score=-1;
  for(const s of usable){
    const mv=MOVES[s.id];let sc;
    if(mv.power){const r=calcDamage(f,p,s);sc=(r.dmg/p.maxhp)*100*(mv.acc/100)*(r.eff>=2?1.4:1)}
    else if(mv.heal)sc=f.hp<f.maxhp*.55?70:2;
    else if(mv.status&&!p.status)sc=26;
    else if(mv.self)sc=f.stages.def<2?22:4;
    else if(mv.target)sc=18;
    else if(mv.special==='roar')sc=p.hp/p.maxhp<.35?55:8;
    else sc=6;
    sc+=Math.random()*14;
    if(sc>score){score=sc;best=s}
  }
  return best;
}
function decideFirst(pSlot,eSlot){
  const pp=pSlot?MOVES[pSlot.id].prio||0:0, ee=eSlot?MOVES[eSlot.id].prio||0:0;
  if(pp!==ee)return pp>ee?'p':'e';
  if(!pSlot)return'e';if(!eSlot)return'p';
  return spdOf(me())>=spdOf(foe())?'p':'e';
}
async function endOfTurn(){
  for(const side of['p','e']){
    const u=side==='p'?me():foe();if(!u||u.hp<=0)continue;
    if(u.status==='PSN'||u.status==='SCORCH'){
      const d=Math.max(1,Math.floor(u.maxhp/10));
      const c=centerOf(side);burst(c.x,c.y,u.status==='PSN'?'smoke':'ember',1);
      await applyDamage(side,u,d);
      await say(`${nm(u)} is hurt by its ${u.status}!`,{hold:420});
      if(u.hp<=0)break;
    }
  }
}

async function chooseAction(){

        items.push({label:'◀ BACK',right:''});

      }
    }else if(i===1){
      while(true){
        const keys=Object.keys(S.items).filter(k=>S.items[k]>0);
        const items=keys.map(k=>({label:ITEMS[k].name,right:'×'+S.items[k],moveId:null}))
          .concat([{label:'◀ BACK',right:''}]);
        const j=await askMenu('bag',items,{hover:idx=>{
          const r=$('#typeReadout');const k=keys[idx];
          if(k)r.innerHTML=`<small>${ITEMS[k].name}</small><div style="font-family:'Space Grotesk';font-size:11.5px;color:#b6bee2;margin-top:6px">${ITEMS[k].desc}</div>`;
        }});
        if(j==='back'||j>=keys.length){closeMenu('back');break}
        const k=keys[j];closeMenu('next');
        if(k==='orb'){
          if(foe()&&foe().sp.catchRate>=255){await say('That one can’t be taken in.');continue}
          return{kind:'orb'};
        }
        if(k==='potion'||k==='superpotion'){
          if(me().hp>=me().maxhp){await say(`${nm(me())} is already at full HP!`,{hold:500});continue}
          return{kind:'item',id:k}
        }
        if(k==='antidote'){
          if(!['PSN','SCORCH'].includes(me().status)){await say('No ailment to flush out.',{hold:500});continue}
          return{kind:'item',id:k}
        }
      }
    }else if(i===2){
      const r=await doSwitch(false);
      if(r===null)continue;
      return{kind:'switch'};
    }else return{kind:'run'};
  }
}

async function battleLoop(){
  while(!S.over){
    const act=await chooseAction();
    if(act.kind==='run'){if(await tryRun()){await finishBattle('DIS-engaged');return}await enemyTurnOnly();if(await checkDeaths())break;continue}
    if(act.kind==='switch'){logLine('Free switch — a classic rule.','sys');continue}
    if(act.kind==='item'){await useItem(act.id);if(await checkDeaths())break;await enemyTurnOnly();if(await checkDeaths())break;await endOfTurn();if(await checkDeaths())break;continue}
    if(act.kind==='orb'){
      const ok=await tryCatch();
      if(ok){await spawnWild();continue}
      await enemyTurnOnly();if(await checkDeaths())break;continue;
    }
    const eSlot=aiChoose();
    const first=decideFirst(act.slot,eSlot);
    const order=first==='p'?[['p',act],['e',eSlot]]:[['e',eSlot],['p',act]];
    for(const [side,a] of order){
      if(!foe()||!me())break;
      if(me().hp<=0||foe().hp<=0)break;
      if(side==='p'){if(a&&a.slot&&a.slot.pp>=0)await useMove(me(),foe(),a.slot,'p')}
      else{if(a)await useMove(foe(),me(),a,'e')}
      if(me().hp<=0||foe().hp<=0||!foe())break;
    }
    if(await checkDeaths())continue;
    await endOfTurn();
    if(await checkDeaths())continue;
  }
}
async function enemyTurnOnly(){
  const e=aiChoose();if(!e||!foe())return;
  await useMove(foe(),me(),e,'e');
}
async function checkDeaths(){
  if(S.over)return true;
  if(foe()&&foe().hp<=0){await enemyFainted();if(S.over)return true;await spawnWild();return true}
  if(!foe()){await spawnWild();return true}
  if(me()&&me().hp<=0){
    await faintMon('p');
    if(!S.party.some(m=>m.hp>0)){await whiteout();return true}
    await forceSwitchOrWhiteout();
    if(S.over)return true;
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

  el.boxE.classList.remove('show');el.boxP.classList.remove('show');
  $('#log').innerHTML='';renderBag();renderParty();renderDex();updateHUD();
  starterScreen();
}
function starterScreen(){
  setMode('choose');
  const opts=['torchlet','splish','blipbloom'];
  overlay(`
    <p class="ov-kick">Field manual · chapter one</p>
    <h2 class="ov-title">CHOOSE YOUR PARTNER</h2>
    <p class="ov-sub">Three juveniles were left on the grass for you. One of them is going to be a handful.</p>
    <div class="podiums">${opts.map(k=>{const s=SPECIES[k];return `
      <div class="podium" data-k="${k}">${spriteSVG(k,false)}
      <div class="pn">${s.name}</div>
      <div class="dexrow" style="justify-content:center">${s.types.map(t=>`<span class="tb ${t}">${t.toUpperCase()}</span>`).join('')}</div>
      <div class="pd">${s.flavor}</div></div>`}).join('')}</div>
    <div class="pickbar"><i id="pb"></i></div>
    <p class="ov-sub" style="font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.2em;text-transform:uppercase">Click a partner, then click again to confirm</p>`);
  let chosen=null;
  $$('.podium').forEach(p=>{
    p.onclick=()=>{
      A.init();A.music();A.sfx.ok();
      if(chosen!==p.dataset.k){chosen=p.dataset.k;$$('.podium').forEach(q=>q.style.borderColor='');
        p.style.borderColor='var(--gold)';$('#pb').style.width='55%'}
      else{$('#pb').style.width='100%';setTimeout(()=>begin(p.dataset.k),380)}
    };
    p.onmouseenter=()=>{A.sfx.cursor()};
  });
}
async function begin(key){
  hideOverlay();
  S.party=[makeMon(key,5)];S.active=0;
  S.items={potion:3,superpotion:1,antidote:1,orb:3};
  renderParty();renderBag();
  el.boxP.classList.add('show');renderMon('p');paintHP('p');
  logLine(`You set out with ${SPECIES[key].name}.`,'sys');
  await say(`That’s ${nm(me())}! You better make it count.`);
  await appearMon('p');
  await say(`${S.trainer} sent out ${nm(me())}!`,{hold:400});
  S.over=false;
  await spawnWild();
  battleLoop();
}
/* keyboard */
const KEYMAP={ArrowUp:'up',ArrowDown:'down',ArrowLeft:'left',ArrowRight:'right',z:'enter',Z:'enter',Enter:'enter',
 ' ':'enter',x:'back',X:'back',Escape:'back',Backspace:'back'};
addEventListener('keydown',e=>{
  if(/^[1-9]$/.test(e.key)){if(menu){askKey(e.key);e.preventDefault()}return}
  const k=KEYMAP[e.key];
  if(k==='enter'&&e.key==='Enter'){if(confirmer){const f=confirmer;confirmer=null;f();e.preventDefault();return}}
  if(k){askKey(k);e.preventDefault();return}
  if(e.key==='m'||e.key==='M'){$('#btnSound').click()}
  if(e.key==='c'||e.key==='C'){$('#btnCrt').click()}
  if(e.key==='h'||e.key==='H'){$('#btnHelp').click()}
});
$('#btnSound').onclick=e=>{A.init();const on=A.toggle();e.currentTarget.classList.toggle('on',on);e.currentTarget.classList.toggle('off',!on);
  e.currentTarget.textContent=on?'♪ SOUND':'♪ MUTED';if(on)A.music()};
$('#btnCrt').onclick=e=>{document.body.classList.toggle('noscan');e.currentTarget.classList.toggle('off',document.body.classList.contains('noscan'))};
$('#btnHelp').onclick=()=>{
  if(!el.overlay.classList.contains('hide')&&$('#ovHelp')){hideOverlay();return}
  overlay(`<p class="ov-kick">Controls</p><h2 class="ov-title">HOW TO FIGHT</h2>
  <div class="kv">
   <b>←↑↓→</b><span>Move the cursor</span>
   <b>Z / ENTER</b><span>Confirm · skip text · advance the ▼</span>
   <b>X / ESC</b><span>Back out of a menu</span>
   <b>1–4</b><span>Jump straight to a move</span>
   <b>M / C</b><span>Toggle sound · toggle scanlines</span>
  </div>
  <p class="ov-sub">Switching partners is <b>free</b> (a Gen-1 rule — punish the AI with it). Orbs catch wilds; weaken or sleep them first.
  Type math uses 1996 physics: ELECTRIC hits FLYING for double, and BUG half-hits POISON.</p>
  <button class="bigbtn" id="ovBtn" data-close="1">CLOSE</button>`);
  $('#ovBtn').onclick=()=>{hideOverlay()};
};
initDefs();
renderBag();
starterScreen();
</script>
